**THE ROLE**

\- **Students and freshers with a genuine interest in business development and events are encouraged to apply.**

**\- This is not a certificate\-only internship.**

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**About Us**

Statcon Electronics India Limited, an ISO 9001:2015 certified company, has been a trusted name in static energy conversion systems since 1986, specializing in Railways, Defence, Power, and Solar sectors. Known for advanced AC and DC technologies, Statcon Electronics’ products are designed for efficiency and resilience in challenging environments. Trusted by industry leaders like Siemens, L\&T, and GE, the company’s global reach includes railway systems across India, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka.

Statcon Electronics India Limited is looking for a dynamic, proactive, and recruitment\-focused HR Intern to support the Talent Acquisition function and contribute to building a strong talent pipeline. Approximately 70% of the role will be dedicated to Recruitment/Talent Acquisition, while approximately 30% will support Onboarding, HR Operations, HR Compliance, and related HR activities.

The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in Recruitment/Talent Acquisition, good knowledge of LinkedIn and other job portals, excellent communication skills, and the ability to proactively source, screen, coordinate, and follow up with candidates. The candidate should be eager to learn, take ownership of hiring requirements, and support HR processes in a fast\-paced environment.

Note: This is an on\-site role based in Noida. We are looking for immediate joiners who are comfortable working from the office.

**Key Responsibilities:** 

* Support approximately 70% of the role in end\-to\-end Recruitment/Talent Acquisition activities, including understanding job requirements, sourcing, screening, shortlisting, interview coordination, candidate follow\-ups, and closure of positions.
* Source candidates proactively through LinkedIn, Naukri and other job portals, social media, employee referrals, databases, and other relevant recruitment channels.
* Demonstrate hands\-on working knowledge of LinkedIn and major job portals, including Boolean/search techniques and effective candidate sourcing methods.
* Screen resumes and applications against job descriptions, qualifications, skills, experience, communication ability, availability, and organizational requirements.
* Conduct initial candidate interactions and screening calls to assess suitability, interest, availability, compensation expectations, and other role\-relevant parameters.
* Coordinate interviews with candidates and hiring managers, including scheduling, confirmations, feedback follow\-ups, and maintaining interview records.
* Maintain and regularly update recruitment trackers, candidate databases, interview status, hiring reports, and recruitment MIS as per the said formats.
* Proactively follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment cycle to improve candidate experience and ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Assist in building and maintaining an active talent pipeline for current and future hiring requirements across functions.
* Support offer coordination, candidate documentation, pre\-joining follow\-ups, and joining formalities for selected candidates.
* Support approximately 30% of the role in onboarding activities, including joining documentation, induction coordination, employee records, and completion of required HR formalities.
* Assist with day\-to\-day HR Operations, including employee documentation, records management, HR trackers, training coordination, and other HR activities as assigned.
* Support HR Compliance activities, including maintaining required records, documentation, trackers, and compliance\-related data as directed by the HR team.
* Support employee engagement initiatives and other HR activities as required, while maintaining a strong focus on recruitment deliverables.
* Proactively suggest ideas to improve sourcing effectiveness, recruitment turnaround time, candidate engagement, onboarding experience, and HR processes.

**Qualifications \& Eligibility** 

* Graduate in any discipline. Preferred educational backgrounds include B.A. (English/HR), BBA, B.Com, Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, General Management, or a related field.
* Candidates with a strong interest in Recruitment/Talent Acquisition and a willingness to build a career in HR will be preferred.
* Good working knowledge of LinkedIn and other job portals is required.
* Immediate joiners preferred.
* Must be willing to work from the Noida office location.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact confidently with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Good practical knowledge of LinkedIn, Naukri and other job portals for candidate sourcing and talent mapping.
* Strong interest in Recruitment/Talent Acquisition, with the ability to manage multiple open positions simultaneously.
* Good resume screening, candidate assessment, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities with attention to detail.
* Strong follow\-up, coordination, and organizational skills.
* Ability to conduct initial candidate screening calls and maintain professional candidate communication.
* Basic understanding or willingness to learn HR Operations, Onboarding, HR documentation, and HR Compliance processes.
* Proactive and target\-oriented approach with ownership of assigned recruitment requirements and timely position closures.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment and maintain accurate recruitment and HR records.

**Required Skills \& Expertise**

Pay: ₹14,999\.00 \- ₹15,001\.00 per month

**Position:** Operations Manager  
**Department:** Operations  
**Location:** Dehradun  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5–10 years  
**Reporting To:** Director / Senior Management

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Operations Manager** to oversee and optimize the day\-to\-day operations of Arteva Consulting Private Ltd. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring operational efficiency, managing teams, improving processes, coordinating with clients and internal stakeholders, and supporting the organization in achieving its business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and oversee daily business operations to ensure smooth and efficient functioning.
* Develop, implement, and monitor operational processes, SOPs, and workflows.
* Lead, manage, and motivate operational teams to achieve performance and productivity targets.
* Allocate resources effectively and monitor utilization of manpower and other operational resources.

**BMC Ferrocast Pvt. Ltd.** is a manufacturing organization operating in the foundry industry. We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **HR Head** to lead the complete HR function and support our growing manufacturing operations.

Job Summary

The HR Head will be responsible for managing and leading all aspects of **Human Resources and Industrial Relations** at the foundry. The role requires strong hands\-on experience in manpower planning, recruitment, employee relations, labour\-law compliance, payroll, contract labour management, performance management, and HR operations.

* Prepare and monitor daily/monthly manpower reports and HR MIS.

* Support management in maintaining workplace discipline.
* Coordinate with workers, supervisors, and department heads to resolve employee\-related concerns.
* Handle industrial relations matters and support management during workforce\-related situations.

* Ensure compliance with applicable requirements relating to contract workers.
* Monitor contractor performance and manpower availability.

* Verify attendance, overtime, leave, deductions, and other payroll inputs.
* Ensure accurate and timely salary processing.
* Coordinate with Finance/Accounts regarding payroll and employee payments.

8\. Training \& Development

* Identify training needs across departments.
* Prepare and implement annual training plans.
* Coordinate technical, safety, behavioural, and skill\-development training programs.
* Maintain training records and evaluate training effectiveness.

9\. Employee Engagement \& Welfare

* Develop employee engagement initiatives.
* Manage employee welfare activities and facilities.
* Organize employee communication and engagement programs.
* Address employee concerns and maintain a positive workplace environment.

10\. Factory HR \& Administration

* Manage day\-to\-day HR activities within the foundry/plant.

* Support implementation of company rules, policies, safety requirements, and workplace discipline.

* Work directly with the Founder on business operations, strategic initiatives, and execution.

* Track tasks, projects, deliverables, deadlines, and follow\-ups.

* Support business research, analysis, and preparation of information required for decision\-making.

* Maintain confidentiality of sensitive business and company information.
* Help make the Founder's day\-to\-day work more organized and efficient by anticipating requirements and taking ownership of follow\-ups.

* A **quick learner** with strong curiosity and willingness to learn.
* Proactive, organized, and responsible.
* Strong in **verbal and written communication**.
* Analytical and comfortable working with information, data, and business processes.
* Able to understand requirements and work independently.
* Strong in problem\-solving and identifying practical solutions.
* Comfortable coordinating with multiple people and following up on tasks.
* Interested in **AI, technology, automation, business, and startups**.

* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* Professional when interacting with senior professionals, consultants, and external stakeholders.

Candidates from Computer Science Background prefered

title: Barista
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – BARISTA

**Position:** Barista  
**Department:** Food \& Beverage / Café Operations  
**Reports To:** Shift Manager / Restaurant Manager  
**Location:** Palm Beach \-Navi Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

1\. JOB PURPOSE

To prepare and serve high\-quality coffee, beverages and other café products while maintaining the Company's standards of beverage quality, presentation, hygiene, guest service and operational efficiency.

The Barista is responsible for delivering a consistent and welcoming guest experience while ensuring adherence to recipes, beverage standards, food safety and company SOPs.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. Beverage Preparation

* Prepare espresso\-based beverages including Espresso, Americano, Cappuccino, Latte, Mocha and other beverages as per approved recipes and standards.
* Prepare hot and cold beverages, smoothies, teas and other menu beverages as assigned.
* Follow standard recipes, portion sizes, temperatures and presentation guidelines.
* Ensure consistency in taste, quality and presentation of every beverage.
* Operate and maintain espresso machines, grinders, blenders and other beverage equipment correctly.
* Perform proper coffee grinding, dosing, tamping and extraction.
* Maintain appropriate milk steaming and texturing standards.
* Ensure beverages are prepared within the Company's prescribed service time.

B. Coffee Knowledge \& Quality

* Maintain knowledge of the Company's coffee, brewing methods and beverage menu.
* Understand basic coffee terminology, extraction, grind size, brewing ratios and milk texturing.
* Conduct quality checks of coffee and beverages.
* Report any inconsistency in coffee beans, milk, ingredients or beverage quality to the Shift Manager.
* Follow approved recipes and do not make unauthorized changes to beverages.

C. Guest Service

* Welcome and interact with guests in a warm, professional and courteous manner.
* Understand guest preferences and provide appropriate beverage recommendations.
* Explain beverages, ingredients and preparation methods when required.
* Practice suggestive selling and recommend suitable beverages, add\-ons and retail products.
* Handle guest requests and complaints professionally and escalate issues to the Manager when required.
* Maintain a positive and professional attitude during busy service periods.

D. Upselling \& Sales

* Actively participate in beverage and retail sales initiatives.
* Recommend premium beverages, add\-ons and complementary food items.
* Promote new launches, seasonal beverages and special offers.
* Achieve individual and outlet\-level sales targets as communicated by Management.
* Support the team in improving average bill value through effective suggestive selling.

E. Hygiene \& Food Safety

* Follow all Company food safety, hygiene and sanitation SOPs.
* Maintain clean hands, uniform, workstation and equipment at all times.
* Follow proper personal grooming and hygiene standards.
* Ensure ingredients are stored correctly and within their approved shelf life.
* Check expiry dates and report expired, damaged or questionable products immediately.
* Prevent cross\-contamination during beverage preparation.
* Follow proper cleaning and sanitization procedures for all equipment and work surfaces.
* Comply with applicable food safety and statutory requirements.

F. Mise en Place \& Inventory

* Complete daily bar mise en place before the start of service.
* Ensure adequate stock of coffee beans, milk/plant\-based milk, syrups, powders, garnishes, cups, lids and other beverage supplies.
* Check opening and closing stock as required.
* Inform the Shift Manager about shortages, wastage or damaged stock.
* Follow proper FIFO/FEFO practices wherever applicable.
* Minimize wastage and maintain responsible portion control.

G. Equipment \& Maintenance

* Operate all coffee and beverage equipment according to Company SOPs.
* Clean the espresso machine, grinder, blender and other equipment at the required frequency.
* Perform daily cleaning and basic maintenance.
* Immediately report equipment malfunction or damage to the Manager.
* Never attempt unauthorized repairs or modifications to equipment.

H. Cleaning \& Closing Duties

* Maintain a clean and organized bar throughout the shift.
* Clean workstations continuously during service.
* Complete end\-of\-shift cleaning and closing procedures.
* Ensure equipment is switched off safely where applicable.
* Store ingredients and products correctly after service.
* Ensure the bar is fully prepared for the next shift.

3\. GROOMING \& PROFESSIONAL STANDARDS

The Barista must:

* Report to duty in complete and prescribed uniform.
* Maintain clean and polished footwear.
* Wear the prescribed name badge.
* Maintain clean and well\-groomed hair.
* Maintain clean and trimmed nails.
* Maintain appropriate personal hygiene at all times.
* Avoid strong perfumes/fragrances that may affect the guest experience.
* Not report to work under the influence of alcohol or any prohibited substance.
* Follow the Company's grooming and uniform SOP at all times.

4\. TRAINING \& DEVELOPMENT

The Barista will be required to participate in:

* New employee induction and orientation.
* Coffee and beverage training.
* Menu and product knowledge training.
* Food safety and hygiene training.
* Guest service training.
* Suggestive selling and upselling training.
* Equipment handling and maintenance training.
* Refresher training and assessments conducted by the Training \& Development team.

Performance may be assessed through practical demonstrations, product knowledge tests, service observations and operational audits.

5\. PERFORMANCE INDICATORS / KPIs

Performance may be evaluated on:

* Beverage quality and consistency.
* Coffee preparation standards.
* Beverage presentation.
* Service speed and accuracy.
* Guest feedback and service quality.
* Beverage and retail sales performance.
* Suggestive selling and upselling.
* Food safety and hygiene compliance.
* Grooming and uniform compliance.
* Attendance and punctuality.
* Equipment handling and maintenance.
* Wastage control.
* Teamwork and communication.
* Compliance with Company SOPs.

6\. AUTHORITY \& ACCOUNTABILITY

The Barista is accountable for the quality, consistency and presentation of beverages prepared at the assigned station.

Any quality issue, equipment malfunction, stock shortage, hygiene concern or guest complaint must be immediately reported to the Shift Manager or Restaurant Manager.

The Barista is also responsible for maintaining the cleanliness, organization and readiness of the assigned beverage station throughout the shift.

7\. QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE

**Preferred:**

* Minimum 1–2 years of experience as a Barista in a café, restaurant, hotel or premium hospitality environment.
* Barista certification or formal coffee training will be an advantage.
* Freshers with relevant training and strong interest in coffee may also be considered.

8\. SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES

* Good knowledge of coffee and beverages.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Guest\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work under pressure during peak hours.
* Strong teamwork and coordination.
* Good time management.
* Willingness to learn and adapt.
* Ability to follow recipes, SOPs and operational standards.
* Professional and disciplined approach to work.

Pay: Up to ₹26,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

Interface with customers, agents, contractors, project managers, and internal stakeholders

description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONHEAD – SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT

**Company:** Industrial Filters \& Fabrics Pvt. Ltd. (IFF)  
**Location:** Manglia, Indore, Madhya Pradesh  
**Department:** Supply Chain Management  
**Position:** Head – Supply Chain Management  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Industrial Manufacturing / Filter Bags \& Non\-Woven Fabrics

ABOUT THE COMPANY

**I**ndustrial Filters \& Fabrics Pvt. Ltd. (IFF) is a manufacturing company specializing in industrial filtration solutions, filter bags, non\-woven fabrics and related products. We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented Head – Supply Chain Management to lead and strengthen our end\-to\-end supply chain operations.

ROLE PURPOSE

The Head – Supply Chain Management will be responsible for managing and optimizing the complete supply chain cycle, including demand planning, production planning, procurement, inventory, stores, logistics, dispatch and supplier management.

The role will focus on ensuring right material, right quantity, right quality, right cost and right time, while maintaining optimum inventory levels and supporting uninterrupted production and timely customer deliveries.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Supply Chain Planning

* Develop and implement an integrated Supply Chain Planning process aligned with business and production requirements.
* Coordinate with Sales, Production, Purchase, Stores and Finance for demand and supply planning.
* Prepare and monitor monthly, weekly and daily material planning.
* Ensure availability of critical raw materials and consumables without excess inventory.
* Identify supply risks and develop contingency plans.

2\. Procurement \& Supplier Management

* Lead strategic procurement of raw materials, consumables, packaging materials and other production requirements.
* Develop and maintain a reliable supplier base.
* Evaluate suppliers based on quality, cost, delivery, capacity and service performance.
* Negotiate commercial terms, prices, lead times and payment conditions.
* Develop alternate sources for critical materials to minimize supply risk.
* Drive supplier performance improvement and timely corrective actions.

3\. Inventory Management

* Establish optimum inventory norms for raw materials, WIP, finished goods and consumables.
* Monitor inventory levels, ageing, slow\-moving and non\-moving inventory.
* Reduce excess inventory and improve inventory turnover.
* Implement appropriate FIFO / FEFO / batch control wherever applicable.
* Establish inventory accuracy through regular cycle counts and physical verification.

4\. Production Planning \& Coordination

* Coordinate with Production to ensure material availability as per production plans.
* Align procurement and inventory plans with production schedules.
* Monitor material shortages, production constraints and line stoppages.
* Improve planning accuracy and reduce production interruptions due to material shortages.

5\. Stores \& Warehouse Management

* Ensure systematic management of raw material, WIP, finished goods and consumables stores.
* Establish proper receiving, inspection, storage, issue and reconciliation systems.
* Improve warehouse space utilization and material identification.
* Ensure inventory records are accurate and updated in ERP/MIS.
* Implement 5S, safety and housekeeping standards across stores and warehouses.

6\. Logistics \& Dispatch

* Lead inbound and outbound logistics operations.
* Ensure timely and cost\-effective movement of materials and finished goods.
* Optimize transportation costs through route, load and transporter planning.
* Monitor dispatch schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Develop and monitor transporter performance and service levels.

7\. Cost Optimization

* Drive continuous reduction in:
* Procurement cost
* Inventory carrying cost
* Transportation cost
* Warehousing cost
* Material handling cost
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, vendor consolidation and better commercial terms.
* Track supply\-chain cost against budgets and targets.

8\. MIS \& Performance Management

Develop and monitor key Supply Chain KPIs such as:

* Material availability %
* Supplier OTIF %
* Purchase price variance
* Inventory turnover
* Inventory days
* Stock\-out frequency
* Slow\-moving / non\-moving inventory
* Procurement lead time
* Purchase order closure
* Logistics cost
* On\-time dispatch %
* Customer delivery adherence
* Working capital blocked in inventory

Prepare regular weekly and monthly Supply Chain MIS for management review.

CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION

The position will work closely with:

Sales \& Marketing \| Production \| Purchase \| Quality \| Stores \| Dispatch \| Finance \| HR \| Management

to ensure seamless flow of materials, information and finished goods across the organization.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

* BE / B.Tech / MBA / PG in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Procurement or related field.
* 10–15 years of relevant experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
* Proven experience in managing end\-to\-end supply chain operations.
* Strong knowledge of procurement, inventory, logistics, warehouse and production planning.
* Experience in ERP systems and advanced MS Excel.
* Strong negotiation and vendor\-management skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong leadership and team\-management capability.
* Should have a data\-driven, process\-oriented and result\-focused approach.

PREFERRED INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE

Candidates from industrial manufacturing, engineering, textile/non\-woven, filtration, automotive, chemical, or other process/manufacturing industries will be preferred.

KEY LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS

Ownership \| Cost Consciousness \| Process Discipline \| Data\-Driven Decision Making \| Vendor Development \| Inventory Optimization \| Customer Focus \| Cross\-Functional Coordination

SUCCESS MEASURES

The successful candidate will be expected to deliver measurable improvement in:

✓ Material Availability  
✓ Inventory Optimization  
✓ Procurement Cost  
✓ Supplier Performance  
✓ Production Continuity  
✓ Logistics Cost  
✓ On\-Time Delivery  
✓ Working Capital Efficiency

WHY JOIN IFF?

This is a leadership opportunity to build and strengthen the Supply Chain Management function and directly contribute to operational efficiency, cost optimization, working\-capital improvement and business growth.

Interested candidates may share their updated CV with the HR Team.

title: PLC Programmer
description:
Electrical Engineer – PLC Programming \& Industrial Automation

**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Department:** Electrical \& Automation  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 2–5 years

1\. Job Purpose

We are looking for an Electrical Engineer with hands\-on experience in **PLC programming, electrical panel design, machine automation, commissioning and troubleshooting**. The candidate will be responsible for developing, integrating and commissioning electrical and control systems for industrial automation projects.

2\. Key Responsibilities

**PLC \& Automation**

* Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC programs for industrial machines and automation systems.
* Work with PLC platforms such as **Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron, Allen\-Bradley, Delta** or equivalent.
* Develop HMI screens, alarms, recipes, data displays and machine\-control sequences.
* Configure and troubleshoot VFDs, servo drives, stepper drives, sensors and actuators.
* Establish communication between PLC, HMI, robots, vision systems, drives and other automation equipment.
* Develop machine sequencing, interlocks, safety logic and fault\-handling routines.
* Participate in FAT, SAT, installation and commissioning activities.

**Electrical Design**

* Prepare electrical control\-panel designs and electrical schematics.
* Select appropriate MCBs, MCCBs, contactors, relays, SMPS, PLCs, I/O modules, drives and other control components.
* Prepare I/O lists, cable schedules, terminal plans and panel layouts.
* Understand industrial control\-panel wiring, earthing and electrical safety requirements.
* Coordinate panel fabrication, wiring and testing.

**Machine Integration**

* Integrate PLCs with **SCARA/6\-axis robots, machine vision systems, screwdrivers, feeders, pneumatic systems and sensors**.
* Interface automation equipment using Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCP/RTU, RS\-232/485 and other industrial communication protocols.
* Support development of automated inspection, assembly, handling and process machines.

**Commissioning \& Troubleshooting**

* Install and commission machines at customer locations.
* Diagnose electrical, PLC, sensor, communication and automation\-related problems.
* Perform machine testing and validation.
* Provide technical support during production trials and customer acceptance.
* Prepare commissioning reports and technical documentation.

3\. Required Technical Skills

* Strong understanding of industrial electrical systems and control circuits.
* Hands\-on PLC programming experience.
* Knowledge of HMI programming.
* Knowledge of VFD/servo drive configuration.
* Ability to read and prepare electrical schematics.
* Knowledge of industrial sensors, solenoid valves, pneumatic systems and safety devices.
* Understanding of industrial communication protocols.
* Basic knowledge of robotics and machine vision will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with AutoCAD Electrical or equivalent electrical\-design software is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot independently using electrical drawings, PLC diagnostics and measuring instruments.

4\. Education \& Experience

**Qualification:**  
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering, Electronics \& Instrumentation Engineering or related discipline.

**Experience:**  
2–5 years in industrial automation, machine building, system integration or manufacturing automation.

Freshers with strong practical PLC knowledge and relevant project experience may also be considered for junior positions.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Job Description: **Technical Trainer** 

**Job post summary**

**Location:** Bangalore (In\-person)  
**Office Base:** Banashankari, Bangalore  
**Travel Requirement:** Travel to partner schools across Bangalore

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Schedule:** Day Shift (Monday to Saturday)

**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹30,000 per month (based on experience)

**About the Role**

We are looking for passionate and enthusiastic **Robotics, AI \& STEM Trainers / STEM Teachers** to deliver engaging, hands\-on learning experiences for school students from **Grades 1 to 10**.

The role involves teaching and facilitating practical learning across **Robotics, Electronics, Coding, Artificial Intelligence, Python, AI\-assisted/vibe coding, 3D Printing, and emerging technologies**.

The trainer will travel to different partner schools across Bangalore to conduct STEM sessions, implement curriculum, guide student projects, and create an engaging environment where students can learn by building and experimenting.

**Key Responsibilities**  
1\. STEM Curriculum Development \& Delivery

* Design and deliver structured STEM lessons covering Robotics, Electronics, Coding, AI, and emerging technologies.
* Customize teaching methods according to different age groups and skill levels.
* Conduct practical and activity\-based sessions that encourage students to learn through experimentation.
* Integrate multiple technologies into project\-based learning activities.

2\. Robotics \& Electronics

* Conduct hands\-on training using robotics kits, Arduino, sensors, motors, and basic electronic components.
* Teach students fundamental concepts of circuits, sensors, automation, and robotics.
* Guide students in building and programming simple robotic systems.
* Assist students in troubleshooting hardware, wiring, and robotics\-kit issues.

3\. Coding \& Python

* Teach beginner\-friendly programming concepts using **block\-based coding and Python**.
* Introduce students to programming fundamentals such as variables, conditions, loops, functions, and basic logic.
* Help students develop small applications, games, automation projects, and robotics programs.
* Introduce age\-appropriate computational thinking and problem\-solving concepts.

4\. Artificial Intelligence \& Generative AI

* Introduce students to the **fundamental concepts of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning** in a simple and age\-appropriate manner.
* Explain concepts such as AI, data, models, computer vision, natural language processing, and generative AI at a basic level.
* Conduct beginner\-friendly AI activities and projects.
* Introduce students to responsible and ethical use of AI.
* Demonstrate how AI tools can be used for learning, creativity, research, and problem\-solving.

5\. AI\-Assisted / Vibe Coding

* Introduce students to **AI\-assisted coding and beginner\-level “vibe coding” concepts**.
* Teach students how to describe an idea clearly and use AI coding assistants to help create simple applications and prototypes.
* Help students understand, test, modify, and debug AI\-generated code rather than simply copying it.
* Encourage students to combine creativity, problem\-solving, and programming to build small functional projects.

6\. 3D Printing \& Digital Fabrication

* Introduce students to the basics of **3D printing and digital fabrication**.
* Explain the basic workflow from idea → 3D design → slicing → printing.
* Guide students through simple 3D design/CAD activities.
* Demonstrate basic 3D\-printer operation, material handling, and print troubleshooting.
* Help students create simple physical prototypes and STEM models.

7\. Project\-Based Learning

* Guide students through practical projects combining robotics, coding, AI, electronics, and 3D printing.
* Encourage students to identify real\-world problems and develop technology\-based solutions.
* Support students in building prototypes and demonstrating their projects.
* Encourage creativity, experimentation, teamwork, and innovation.

8\. Classroom Instruction \& Student Engagement

* Conduct interactive and engaging sessions for students from Grades 1–10\.
* Create a positive classroom environment that encourages curiosity and experimentation.
* Explain technical concepts in a simple and student\-friendly manner.
* Manage classrooms effectively while maintaining a hands\-on learning environment.

9\. Student Assessment \& Feedback

* Monitor student progress and maintain performance records.
* Evaluate student understanding through activities, projects, and practical assessments.
* Provide constructive feedback to help students improve their technical and problem\-solving skills.
* Identify students who require additional guidance and support.

10\. Technical Support \& Troubleshooting

* Assist students in troubleshooting robotics kits, electronics, programming, AI tools, and 3D\-printing activities.
* Diagnose basic hardware and software issues during classroom sessions.
* Ensure STEM equipment and kits are properly maintained and ready for use.

11\. Mentorship

* Inspire students to explore Robotics, AI, Coding, Electronics, and other STEM fields.
* Encourage critical thinking, creativity, problem\-solving, and independent learning.
* Help students develop confidence in building and experimenting with technology.

12\. Collaboration \& Coordination

* Work closely with school teachers, administrators, and internal academic teams.
* Coordinate schedules and ensure smooth execution of STEM sessions across multiple schools.
* Maintain effective communication with school staff regarding student activities and requirements.

13\. Professional Development

* Stay updated with developments in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Python, coding, 3D printing, and STEM education.
* Continuously explore new educational technologies, AI tools, project ideas, and teaching methodologies.
* Participate in internal training and upskilling programs.

Qualifications

**Education:** Diploma / BSc / BE / B.Ed / M.Sc / M.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, Physics, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields.

Candidates from other technical or STEM backgrounds with relevant practical skills may also be considered.

Experience

* Freshers are welcome; structured training will be provided.
* 1–2 years of experience in Robotics, STEM education, coding, AI education, or related areas is preferred.
* Experience working with school students or conducting workshops is an advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of **Robotics and Electronics**.
* Basic programming knowledge in **Arduino, Python, or Block\-based Coding**.
* Basic understanding of **Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI concepts**.
* Familiarity with **AI\-assisted coding / vibe coding** is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of **3D printing and digital fabrication** is an advantage.
* Strong communication and classroom\-management skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and engaging manner.
* Ability to engage and motivate students.
* Good organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Passion for STEM education, technology, and teaching.
* Willingness to travel to partner schools across Bangalore.

**Additional Benefits**

* Structured training and upskilling programs for freshers.
* Exposure to Robotics, AI, Python, 3D Printing, and emerging technologies.
* Opportunity to work with reputed schools across Bangalore.
* Hands\-on experience delivering technology education to school students.
* Opportunity to develop expertise across multiple areas of STEM education.
* Strong career growth opportunities in the **EdTech, Robotics, AI, and STEM education sectors**.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Business Development Manager
company: Kathputlee Arts and Films Pvt Ltd
description:
**Business Development Manager**

**HEAD OF BUSINESS**

Advertising \& Video Production \| Kathputlee Arts \& Films Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:** Hybrid \| **Type:** Full\-time \| **Reports to:** Founder

**This is not a sales job. This is the business.**

We are looking for one person who will own Kathputlee's entire business function: from the first client call to the final invoice. No team to hide behind, no leads handed over, no one checking in on your day. You build it, you run it, you answer for it.

**About Kathputlee Arts \& Films**

Kathputlee Arts \& Films is a creative production house working with leading brands and agencies on ad films, corporate films, animation, timelapse projects, branded content, and social media campaigns, alongside our own slate of original films in active development and theatrical release.

We are not a vendor selling video packages. We are a production house with real creative and film credibility. We need someone who can sell that story because they have lived it.

**The Role**

You will take complete ownership of Kathputlee's business development. Nothing about this role is shared, supervised, or handed down. You will:

■ **Build the business function from scratch**, including pipeline, pricing conversations, client relationships, and revenue.

■ **Bring in paying clients from Day 1** using your existing industry network.

■ **Run the full sales cycle independently:** prospecting, pitching, negotiation, closing, and collections.

■ **Be the single point of accountability** for business growth, reporting results to the Founder rather than daily activity.

■ Work with the creative and production teams to shape proposals and pitches that win.

■ Build long\-term, repeat client relationships with brands, agencies, and corporates.

**You will be treated as a partner in the business, and you will be measured like one: on revenue, not effort.**

**YOU OWN THE NUMBER.**

The expectation is not simply: “I generated 20 leads.”

The expectation is: “I brought business, closed projects and generated revenue.”

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Non\-negotiable**

■ **Current or recent experience at an ad film / video production house or advertising agency.** You understand production budgets, timelines, agency workflows, and how brand briefs turn into films.

■ **An active client network you can bring with you.** Brand marketing heads, agency producers, corporate communications teams: people who will take your call this month.

■ **A proven record of independently building or running a business vertical.** You have started something from zero before, whether a new client base, a service line, a regional market, or your own venture, without a support team.

■ **Closed revenue, not generated leads.** You can point to projects you personally brought in and closed.

■ **Complete self\-drive.** You don't need to be told what to do next, and you don't need to be followed up on.

· Strong understanding of how production projects are pitched, priced, negotiated and closed.

**You'll also bring**

■ Strong pitching, negotiation, and closing ability with senior decision\-makers.

■ Commercial judgement on pricing, margins, and which clients are worth pursuing.

■ The credibility to represent Kathputlee in a room with a CMO or an agency creative head.

**CRITICAL REQUIREMENT — EXISTING INDUSTRY NETWORK**

**An existing network is strongly preferred and will be a major consideration.**

The candidate should already have relationships with relevant Brands, Advertising Agencies, Media Agencies, Corporates, Marketing Heads, Brand Managers, Creative Heads, Agency Decision\-Makers and Production Buyers.

We are looking for someone who can say: “These are the clients/agencies I know, these are the relationships I can activate, these are the services I can sell, and this is the business I can realistically pursue.”

The candidate should be able to demonstrate actual business previously generated, while respecting confidentiality and contractual obligations.

**Please Do Not Apply If**

■ You are a fresher or early in your sales career.

■ Your background is outside advertising, film, or video production (IT sales, real estate, FMCG, insurance, EdTech, general B2B, etc.).

■ You are looking to "give it a try" or learn the industry on the job.

■ You need a structured team, assigned leads, or close supervision to perform.

■ Your experience is limited to lead generation, telecalling, or inside sales.

■ Candidates whose experience is primarily cold calling without closing responsibility.

■ Candidates who do not understand video production, advertising or creative services.

■ Candidates who require extensive training before approaching clients.

■ Candidates expecting a ready\-made client database or existing pipeline.

■ Candidates looking for a role where responsibilities are assigned and monitored daily.

*We say this plainly to respect your time and ours.****This is not an opportunity to learn the production business. The candidate should already know the business and be capable of operating independently.***

**What We Will Discuss in the Interview**

Come prepared to talk about:

**1\.** **Your network:** the types of brands, agencies, and decision\-makers you can approach right now.

**2\.** **Your track record:** projects and revenue you have personally brought in, with approximate deal sizes.

**3\.** **Your independent build:** a business, vertical, or client base you built from scratch.

**4\.** **Your first 30 days:** a practical business plan with a realistic revenue projection for Kathputlee.

*Please do not share confidential client information.*

**Compensation**

**Fixed monthly salary \+ performance incentive on realised revenue**

Fixed pay will be based on experience and the strength of the existing client network. Incentives are uncapped and linked directly to business closed and collected. The more you build, the more you earn.

Pay: Up to ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.


* **Role type:** Full time
* **Location:** Remote and/or Bangalore
* **Working days:** Monday–Saturday
* **Experience:** 1–3 years in recruiting, HR, or both
* **Working with:** Founders and team leads


Weekday is an AI\-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white\-collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.


**About the role**
------------------



We help hundreds of companies hire. This role is about hiring for ourselves — and looking after the people once they're here.



Your week will be roughly half talent acquisition and half people ops. One morning you're sourcing candidates for an ops role using the same database and outbound tools our customers pay for. That afternoon you're onboarding a new joiner, chasing payroll inputs, or sorting out a leave policy question nobody has asked before.



This is not a "post the JD and wait" recruiting job, and it's not an "HR admin in a back office" job. You will be close to the founders, you will see every hire we make, and you will be the person the team comes to when something people\-related needs fixing.

  


**What you'll actually do**
---------------------------



On any given day you might be:


* Sourcing and running outbound to candidates for Weekday's own roles — ops, sales, customer success, engineering, interns — using the Weekday platform
* Screening candidates, scheduling interviews, collecting feedback from hiring managers, and pushing decisions to closure within days, not weeks
* Running offers, background checks, and joining formalities so nobody falls through the cracks between "yes" and day one
* Owning onboarding end\-to\-end: laptops, access, documents, buddy, first\-week plan
* Keeping HR records, attendance, leave, and payroll inputs clean and on time every month
* Handling exits properly — full and final, handovers, and a real exit conversation
* Tracking hiring and people numbers (time to hire, offer acceptance, attrition) and flagging what's off


You'll be measured on whether things got done — well, and on time. Not on slides.


**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* 1–3 years in recruiting, HR, or both. Startup or agency recruiting experience is a strong plus.
* You've actually closed hires — you know what it takes to move a candidate from "maybe" to "joined".
* You're organised to a fault. Offer letters, payroll inputs and documents don't slip on your watch.
* You communicate clearly and warmly, with candidates and with the team. You can have an awkward conversation without making it worse.
* You handle confidential information like it's confidential.
* You move fast and figure things out without a playbook — and when there's no process, you write one.
* You're comfortable with a Monday–Saturday pace and a small team where everyone pitches in.

**What you get**
----------------


* A front\-row seat to how a profitable, venture\-backed startup hires and builds its team
* Hands\-on use of India's largest white\-collar talent database and our outbound tools — skills most recruiters never get to build
* Direct exposure to the founders and how people decisions actually get made
* Real ownership: the hiring and people ops you run will be the way Weekday does it
* A clear path to grow into a People Lead role as the team scales
  


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Human Resources Manager (India )
description:
Key Responsibilities
 



  





 1\. Build the India HR system from the ground up
 



 \- Register and establish the India subsidiary / legal entity, liaising with local legal counsel, registration agents and banks
 



 \- Build a full\-process HR system: recruitment, onboarding \& offboarding, attendance, payroll, performance, training and employee relations
 



 \- Lead HRIS / Payroll selection and implementation, integrated with China HQ digital platforms
 



 \- Develop India\-localized employee handbook, policies and procedures (bilingual CN\-EN)
 



  





 2\. Workforce management across plant construction phases
 



 \- Infrastructure: manage labor compliance of EPC contractors, civil contractors and outsourced crews — BOCW welfare fund, contract\-worker registration, minimum wage and working\-hours compliance
 



 \- Commissioning: recruit and onboard core operations roles (plant manager, production manager, quality, equipment maintenance) with the engineering team
 



 \- Mass\-production ramp\-up: lead large\-scale hiring, build stable channels (ITI / Polytechnic / local agencies) and manage high turnover
 



 \- Define headcount plans, hiring pace and budgets with business leaders at each phase
 



  





 3\. India labor law compliance and risk management
 



 \- Implement central and state\-level labor laws covering employment, social security, wages and benefits
 



 \- Handle labor disputes, union communications and regulatory inspections with local counsel and accountants; Tamil Nadu's strong union tradition requires proactive communication and grievance mechanisms
 



 \- Establish the POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) committee and internal grievance mechanism
 



 \- Coordinate HR\-related requirements in plant permits (Factory Inspectorate / Pollution Control Board / Fire NOC)
 



  





 4\. Chinese expatriate management and localization
 



 \- Handle Employment / Business Visa applications, renewals and dependent visas
 



 \- Coordinate personal income tax filing, FEMA compliance and social security arrangements
 



 \- Build expatriate support: housing, transportation, healthcare, children's schooling
 



 \- Drive cross\-cultural integration between Chinese and Indian teams
 



  





 5\. Recruitment, compensation and talent development
 



 \- Lead hiring for core local roles (plant manager, operations manager, sales, technical, finance)
 



 \- Build India\-market recruiting channels and employer branding (Naukri, LinkedIn India, local universities)
 



 \- Design market\-competitive compensation balancing local benchmarks and China HQ structures
 



 \- Drive talent development, performance management and succession planning in a 15\-25% turnover market
 



  





 6\. HQ collaboration and reporting
 



 \- Report India HR progress, risks and recommendations to the China HQ HRD
 



 \- Contribute India\-market perspectives to global HR policy
 



 \- Support cross\-functional coordination with HQ in finance, tax, legal and administration
 



  





 Qualifications
 



  





 \- Work experience: 8\+ years in HR, including 3\-5 years of hands\-on HR management in India; plant construction preparation experience strongly preferred
 



 \- Industry background: factory HR experience in manufacturing (PV / electronics / automotive / appliances), able to independently support a 200\+ employee plant through infrastructure to mass production
 



 \- Overseas experience: hands\-on experience in Chinese companies' expansion into India; familiar with China\-India team collaboration pain points and solutions
 



 \- Compliance: proficient in Indian laws and regulations, with practical experience in labor disputes, regulatory inspections and union communications
 



 \- Language: English as working language, communicating fluently with local employees, government agencies and lawyers; Hindi / Tamil a plus
 



 \- Cultural adaptability: deep understanding of India's diverse cultures, religions and employee expectations; open to long\-term posting in India
 



 \- Adaptability: comfortable with the high\-dynamics, high\-intensity pace of the plant build\-up phase

It’s why we’re committed to giving back to the communities where we live and work.  Lead the India Total Rewards and HR Shared Services function by designing and executing compensation and benefits programs, delivering efficient HR operations, and ensuring an exceptional employee experience. Partner with global Centres of Excellence (COEs), HR Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders to drive reward strategies, operational excellence, compliance, and people processes.

* Monitor and analyse key HR metrics including headcount, attrition, hiring, compensation, span of control, and employee experience to support business decision\-making.
* Partner with global HR COEs on HRIS enhancements, process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support workforce planning, budgeting, and organizational changes through robust people analytics and reporting.

* Lead and support enterprise HR initiatives, policy implementations, and transformation projects that improve operational effectiveness and employee experience.

**Company:** USN IT Solutions  
**Location:** Remote / Work From Home  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Compensation:** ₹15,000/month \+ Placement Incentives/Commission

**About the Role**

USN IT Solutions is looking for a **proactive IT Recruitment \& Candidate Marketing Consultant** who will be responsible for identifying suitable IT job opportunities and actively marketing our candidates to those opportunities.

This is **not a traditional HR/recruiter role**. The primary focus of this position is to **market IT candidates, search for relevant job openings, submit candidate profiles, build recruiter/client relationships, and generate interview opportunities**.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with **LinkedIn, Dice, job boards, and other online recruitment platforms**, and should have a strong understanding of the US IT staffing/recruitment market.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Search daily for relevant **US IT job openings** on LinkedIn, Dice, Indeed, ZipRecruiter, and other job portals.
* Match available candidates with suitable job requirements based on skills, experience, location, work authorization, rate, and job requirements.
* **Market and promote candidate profiles** to relevant recruiters, staffing companies, vendors, and clients.
* Submit candidate resumes/profiles to appropriate job openings and recruitment contacts.
* Use **LinkedIn and Dice** to identify recruiters, hiring managers, staffing companies, and potential opportunities.
* Build and maintain a network of **US IT recruiters, vendors, clients, and staffing contacts**.
* Send candidate profiles through LinkedIn, email, job portals, and other professional channels.
* Follow up regularly with recruiters and vendors regarding submitted candidates.
* Track submissions, responses, interviews, feedback, and candidate status in internal records.
* Coordinate with candidates regarding availability, interviews, requirements, and submission details.
* Understand common US IT staffing terminology such as **W2, C2C, 1099, Corp\-to\-Corp, contract, contract\-to\-hire, remote, onsite, hybrid, visa/work authorization, and bill rate**.
* Identify new opportunities for candidates and continuously work on increasing interview and placement opportunities.
* Meet daily/weekly activity and submission targets.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **sales\-oriented, proactive, and comfortable with online research and outreach**.

**Required Skills**

* Good knowledge of **LinkedIn and online job portals**.
* Strong internet research and job\-search skills.
* Good written and verbal English communication.
* Ability to identify suitable IT jobs based on a candidate's resume.
* Ability to communicate professionally with US recruiters and staffing companies.
* Strong follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable working with daily targets and activity goals.
* Ability to work independently from home.
* Basic understanding of IT roles such as **Software Developer, Java Developer, .NET Developer, Data Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, SAP Consultant, QA Engineer, Business Analyst, etc.**

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* US IT Recruitment
* IT Staffing
* Bench Sales
* IT Candidate Marketing
* IT Recruitment Marketing
* Candidate Marketing
* US Staffing
* Recruitment/Sales
* LinkedIn Recruiting
* Dice Recruiting
* Vendor Management
* Business Development for IT Staffing

**Freshers with strong communication skills and a genuine interest in US IT staffing may also be considered.**

**Important: This Is a Target\-Driven Role**

The core responsibility is to **find jobs and market candidates**.

You will be expected to spend a significant part of your day:

**Finding Jobs → Matching Candidates → Marketing Candidates → Submitting Profiles → Following Up → Generating Interviews → Supporting Placements**

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys **online job hunting, networking, LinkedIn outreach, sales, follow\-ups, and working toward measurable placement results**.

**Compensation**

* **Monthly Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹25,000**, based on experience and relevant skills
* **Additional placement incentives/commission**

* Performance\-based growth opportunities

**Working Hours**

The role requires availability aligned with **US business hours**, as the position involves communicating with US recruiters, staffing companies, and clients.

**How to Apply**

Please apply with your updated resume highlighting any experience in **US IT recruitment, staffing, bench sales, candidate marketing, LinkedIn recruiting, Dice, job portals, or recruitment sales**.

description:
**Telecalling Executive – Digital Lending / Payday Loans**

**Department:** Sales / Customer Acquisition  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reporting To:** Team Leader  
**Industry:** NBFC

1\. Job Overview / Summary

We are looking for energetic, customer\-focused, and target\-driven **Telecallers** to support our digital lending/payday loan business. The role involves engaging with prospective and existing customers through inbound and outbound calls, understanding their borrowing requirements, explaining loan products and applicable terms clearly, and assisting them through the application and documentation process.

The ideal candidate should possess strong communication and persuasion skills while maintaining a professional and ethical approach to customer interactions. All customer communication must be transparent, respectful, and strictly aligned with the Company's policies, approved scripts, applicable lending regulations, and data privacy requirements.

2\. Key Responsibilities

* Make **outbound calls** to prospective and existing customers from Company\-approved leads and databases for eligible loan products.
* Handle **inbound customer enquiries** relating to loan applications, eligibility, documentation, application status and product features.
* Understand the customer's borrowing requirements and explain suitable loan products in a clear and professional manner.
* Clearly communicate key loan terms, including **loan amount, tenure, repayment schedule, interest/APR, processing fees and other applicable charges**, as prescribed by the Company.
* Ensure that customers are not provided with misleading information or unrealistic commitments regarding loan approval, disbursement, pricing or eligibility.
* Assist customers in completing loan applications and guide them through the required **KYC and documentation process**.
* Perform preliminary validation of customer information, including employment, income, contact details and other application information, as per prescribed processes.
* Follow up with customers for pending information or documentation required to process their applications.
* Accurately update customer interactions, call outcomes, follow\-up dates and application status in the **CRM/loan management system**.
* Coordinate with credit, operations, verification and customer support teams for timely processing of eligible applications.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with leads while respecting customer preferences, consent requirements and applicable communication restrictions.
* Achieve assigned **daily, weekly and monthly targets** relating to calls, qualified leads, applications, conversions and disbursements.
* Maintain high standards of call quality and customer experience while working toward business targets.
* Follow Company\-approved calling scripts, sales practices, customer communication guidelines and escalation procedures.
* Maintain complete confidentiality of customer data and use customer information only for authorized business purposes.
* Promptly escalate customer complaints, disputes, suspected fraud or unusual cases to the appropriate team.
* Participate in regular product, sales, compliance and process training.

3\. Requirements \& Qualifications

**Education**

* Graduate candidates will be preferred.

**Experience**

* Freshers with strong communication skills may apply.
* **6 months–2 years of experience** in telecalling, telesales, customer service, fintech, NBFC, banking, insurance, credit cards or personal loan sales will be preferred.
* Previous experience in digital lending, personal loans, short\-term loans or other financial products will be an advantage.

**Communication \& Language**

* Strong verbal communication skills.
* Fluency in **Hindi** is required.
* Working proficiency in **English** is preferred.
* Ability to communicate financial information to customers in simple and understandable language.

**Technical Requirements**

* Basic computer proficiency, including MS Office and internet\-based applications.
* Familiarity with **CRM software, dialer systems, lead management platforms or loan management systems** is preferred.
* Ability to accurately record and update customer information in digital systems.

4\. Key Skills \& Core Competencies

* **Persuasion \& Negotiation:** Ability to communicate product benefits effectively without resorting to aggressive or misleading selling practices.
* **Active Listening:** Ability to understand customer requirements, concerns and objections before recommending appropriate next steps.
* **Customer Orientation:** Professional, courteous and respectful approach toward customers throughout the interaction.
* **Target Orientation:** Strong motivation to achieve assigned sales and productivity targets.
* **Resilience:** Ability to handle rejection, objections and high call volumes while maintaining professionalism.
* **Product Understanding:** Ability to learn loan products, eligibility parameters, pricing and processes quickly.
* **Compliance Mindset:** Strong commitment to following approved processes, scripts, regulatory requirements and ethical selling standards.
* **Accuracy \& Attention to Detail:** Careful handling of customer information, documentation and CRM updates.
* **Data Confidentiality:** Responsible handling of sensitive customer and financial information.
* **Teamwork:** Ability to coordinate effectively with sales, credit, operations, verification and customer support teams.

5\. Compliance \& Ethical Selling Expectations

As the role involves customer interaction for financial products, the employee is expected to maintain the highest standards of professional conduct.

The Telecaller must:

* Provide customers with **clear, accurate and transparent information** regarding the loan product and applicable charges.
* Never misrepresent loan eligibility, approval probability, disbursement timelines, interest rates, fees or repayment obligations.
* Never pressure or intimidate a customer into taking a loan.
* Obtain and handle customer information only through approved channels and processes.
* Follow applicable **KYC, customer consent, data privacy, fair\-practice and digital\-lending requirements**, along with the Company's internal policies.
* Avoid making commitments outside the employee's authorized scope.
* Immediately escalate customer grievances and compliance concerns through prescribed channels.
* Maintain respectful communication irrespective of whether a customer proceeds with the loan.

**Achievement of sales targets must never take precedence over regulatory compliance, ethical conduct or fair treatment of customers.**

6\. What We Offer / Benefits

* **Competitive fixed salary** based on experience and communication skills.
* Attractive **performance\-linked incentives and bonuses** based on defined achievement criteria.
* Structured induction and training on loan products, sales processes, CRM systems and compliance requirements.
* Regular coaching and performance feedback from experienced team leaders.
* Opportunity to build a career in the rapidly growing **Fintech/NBFC and digital lending industry**.
* Career progression opportunities to roles such as **Senior Telecaller, Team Leader, Quality Analyst, Customer Relationship Executive or Sales Manager**, subject to performance and organizational requirements.
* Professional, energetic and performance\-oriented working environment.
* Recognition and rewards for consistent performance and quality customer service.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for candidates who are **energetic, confident, disciplined and target\-oriented**, but who also understand that lending is a regulated financial activity requiring responsible customer communication.

The successful candidate will combine strong sales ability with **transparency, empathy, process discipline and ethical selling practices** to generate business while maintaining a positive customer experience.

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee – Seating Foam
description:
**Job Description**

As a **Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Seating Foam**, you will support the design and development of automotive seating foam components using **Siemens NX**. You will assist in creating, modifying, and detailing 3D CAD models, preparing engineering drawings, and supporting product development activities.

The role provides an opportunity to develop practical knowledge of **Siemens NX, automotive seating foam design, engineering drawings, GD\&T, design standards, and product development processes** while working with cross\-functional engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and modify **3D seating foam models using Siemens NX**.
* Develop and update automotive seating foam components based on design requirements.
* Prepare and modify **2D engineering drawings and manufacturing documentation in Siemens NX**.
* Perform basic **part modeling, assembly modeling, drafting, and design modifications** in Siemens NX.
* Support engineering changes, design updates, and revision activities.
* Apply basic **GD\&T, dimensional requirements, tolerances, and engineering standards** to drawings.
* Support the development of **seat cushion, seat back, headrest, and other foam\-related components**.
* Coordinate with **Design, Manufacturing, Tooling, CAE, Quality, and Prototype teams**.
* Maintain engineering documents, **BOMs, drawing revisions, and CAD data**.
* Participate in design reviews, prototype development, validation, and testing activities.
* Support design improvements based on manufacturing, testing, and customer requirements.
* Ensure CAD models and drawings follow **company, customer, and automotive design standards**.
* Learn and follow established **Siemens NX modeling and drafting methodologies**.

**Qualification**

* Diploma in **Mechanical Engineering / Automobile Engineering**.
* BE/B.Tech in **Mechanical Engineering / Automobile Engineering**.
* Freshers and recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

**Required Skills**

* Basic to intermediate knowledge of **Siemens NX**.
* Knowledge of **NX 3D Modeling, Assembly, and Drafting**.
* Understanding of automotive **seating foam component design** is an added advantage.
* Basic understanding of **engineering drawings and GD\&T fundamentals**.
* Knowledge of basic **automotive product development processes**.
* Understanding of basic **manufacturing and tooling concepts**.
* Ability to interpret design requirements and convert them into CAD models.
* Good analytical, communication, and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to learn advanced **Siemens NX tools and automotive seating design processes**.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced automotive engineering environment.

Pay: ₹17,000\.00 \- ₹18,500\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Software Development Engineer II, Prime Video Resilience, Prime Video App Experience
description:
**Description**
 Are you excited about making sure millions of viewers can enjoy their favorite content without interruption? The Prime Video Resilience team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to help us ensure our services are ready to scale safely and efficiently. We sit at the core of Prime Video's resilience layer, where we identify scalability blockers, build frameworks and tools that let service teams handle massive concurrent viewership, and do it all without impacting real customers.
   

  

 You will design and deliver solutions that enable other engineering teams to focus on business logic while your work quietly ensures their services can scale. If you enjoy solving complex systems problems, thinking about graph patterns and distributed architectures, and shipping tools that have organization\-wide impact, this role will give you that opportunity.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and build scalability testing frameworks and tools that help Prime Video services validate their readiness to support millions of concurrent viewers safely and without customer impact.
* Identify and resolve scalability blockers across services by analyzing system dependencies, load characteristics, and failure modes, then implementing permanent fixes at the root cause.
* Collaborate with service teams across Prime Video to help them understand scalability challenges and adopt the frameworks your team builds, coaching them on best practices along the way.
* Contribute across the full software development lifecycle — from working backwards on requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations — while maintaining high code quality and clear documentation.
* Evaluate new approaches and technologies for scale\-readiness tooling, recommending adoption where appropriate and keeping your solutions straightforward rather than over\-engineered.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You will spend much of your time working independently — diving deep into system architectures, profiling service behavior under load, and writing code for the tools and frameworks that power Prime Video's scale\-readiness program. On other days, you will partner with service teams to walk through their scalability challenges, propose solutions, and help them integrate your tooling. As an individual contributor, you will balance heads\-down engineering with collaborative problem\-solving sessions, gaining broad exposure to the systems and patterns that keep Prime Video running at scale.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Prime Video Resilience team is responsible for ensuring that Prime Video's services can scale to meet the demands of millions of concurrent viewers worldwide. We build the frameworks, tools, and approaches that let service teams prove their scale readiness efficiently, so they can stay focused on delivering great customer experiences. Our work has organization\-wide impact, and we are always looking for new ways to make scalability validation simpler and more effective. If you want to grow your expertise in distributed systems, graph patterns, and large\-scale architecture while shipping solutions that matter across Prime Video, this is the team for you.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Location: Lodha Supremus, Andheri East, Mumbai \| Full\-time or 3–6 month internship \| ₹25,000–₹45,000 per month

About us

Kridha Advisors is a Mumbai\-based investment banking and capital markets advisory firm, powered by and operating as an extended arm of Khandwala Securities Limited — a Tier 1 SEBI\-registered Merchant Banker. That association gives our team the reach and regulatory standing of an established merchant banking platform, combined with the pace and ownership of a lean advisory practice.

We work across SME and mainboard IPOs, pre\-IPO placements, secondary market fundraising for listed entities, M\&A and structured advisory — from early\-stage startups to established growth companies.

You’ll sit inside live transactions rather than on the sidelines of them. Day to day, that means:

* Genuine appetite for deal work: long hours during live mandates, high ownership, direct exposure to promoters and investors.

Why join

Small team, no layers, backed by a SEBI\-registered merchant banking platform. You’ll see a transaction end\-to\-end — origination, structuring, documentation, negotiation, closure — within your first few months, across both primary and secondary market mandates. Compensation is benchmarked to demonstrated capability, not just years on a CV.

To apply

Send your CV to admin@kridhaadvisors.in with the subject line “Application — IB Analyst” and a short note on a deal or company you’ve found interesting recently and why.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**
 The SOC Analyst (L1\) is the first line of detection and response within Revantage's Security Operations Center, responsible for continuous monitoring of security alerts, performing initial triage, and ensuring timely escalation to L2 analysts. The role operates using the ReliaQuest GreyMatter MDR platform as the primary investigation interface, supported by Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Sentinel for alert review and basic log analysis. The L1 Analyst is expected to develop strong foundational skills across the Revantage security toolset, maintain disciplined documentation practices, and contribute to consistent shift handoff quality. This is a growth\-oriented role designed to build the analytical foundation for progression to L2 responsibilities.
   

  

**Essential Job Duties**
* Alert Monitoring \& Initial Triage
* Monitor the security alert queue continuously across shift, ensuring no alerts are missed, delayed, or left without an initial disposition.
* Perform initial triage of incoming alerts: review alert context, classify by type and potential severity, and determine whether the alert warrants escalation or closure as a false positive.
* Apply documented playbooks and runbooks to guide triage decisions; escalate promptly to L2 when an alert exceeds L1 scope or confidence threshold.
* Maintain accurate, timely documentation of all triage actions: alert details, initial findings, disposition rationale, and escalation notes.
* Support shift handoff quality by ensuring all open items are clearly documented and communicated to the incoming analyst.
* ReliaQuest GreyMatter
* Use GreyMatter as the primary platform for alert review, case management, and initial investigation workflows.
* Navigate GreyMatter case queues, apply filters, and use built\-in enrichment and AI\-assisted features to support triage decisions — always validating outputs before acting.
* Document findings, disposition notes, and escalation rationale within GreyMatter case records in accordance with SOC documentation standards.
* Develop proficiency with GreyMatter investigation workflows through structured on\-the\-job learning and guidance from L2 analysts and the SOC Manager.
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
* Review MDE alerts surfaced through GreyMatter or the MDE portal; understand alert categories, severity levels, and associated device context.
* Perform basic endpoint investigation tasks: review device timelines for obvious indicators, check process trees, and identify key artifacts to include in escalation notes.
* Understand and apply MDE alert triage criteria to support accurate initial severity classification.
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Review Sentinel incidents and alerts as part of the monitoring queue; understand alert sources and the log types that feed detections.
* Run basic KQL queries using provided templates to retrieve log evidence and support initial triage findings.
* Develop foundational KQL proficiency over time, progressing toward independent query construction for common triage scenarios.
* SSE/SWG Platforms — Zscaler \& Netskope
* Develop working familiarity with Zscaler and Netskope alert types, log sources, and basic policy constructs.
* Review web security alerts and support L2 analysts with initial context gathering for Zscaler and Netskope\-related investigations.
* Follow documented workflows for reporting and escalating SSE/SWG events that exceed L1 triage capability.
* ServiceNow Ticket Handling
* Manage ServiceNow tickets assigned to the InfoSec/SOC queue: acknowledge, classify, document, and escalate or resolve within SLA.
* Handle routine, low\-complexity security tickets: user\-reported suspicious emails, access queries, and basic security tool questions — following documented resolution procedures.
* Maintain accurate ticket records: classification, evidence summary, actions taken, and resolution notes aligned to SOC documentation standards.
* Flag repeat patterns or unresolved issues for L2 review and knowledge article creation.
* Email Security
* Perform initial triage of user\-reported phishing and suspicious email submissions using Mimecast and/or Abnormal.ai.
* Apply documented phishing triage criteria: assess sender, links, attachments, and headers; classify and escalate confirmed or suspected malicious emails to L2\.
* Support quarantine and release workflows under L2 direction; document findings and outcomes in the relevant ticket or case record.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 1\+ years of experience in a SOC, IT operations, helpdesk, or security monitoring role.
* Basic understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, common ports and protocols.
* Familiarity with Windows operating system concepts: processes, services, event logs, and common file system paths.
* Awareness of common attack types and indicators: phishing, malware, credential abuse, and suspicious scripting.
* Ability to follow structured procedures, playbooks, and escalation paths with precision and consistency.
* ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tool experience: ticket creation, classification, and documentation.
* Strong attention to detail and clear written communication for ticket notes, case documentation, and shift handoffs.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior exposure to a SIEM platform (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, or similar) for alert review or basic log analysis.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent EDR tooling.
* Exposure to phishing analysis and email security tools (Mimecast, Abnormal.ai, or similar).
* Understanding of the MITRE ATT\&CK framework at a foundational level.
* Experience working in a 24×7 shift environment.


**EDUCATION \& CERTIFICATIONS**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* CompTIA Security\+ — preferred or actively pursuing.
* Microsoft SC\-900 (Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals) — a plus.
* CompTIA CySA\+ or equivalent — desirable as a development target.


**SUCCESS MEASURES**
* SLA compliance and accurate, complete documentation for all assigned ServiceNow tickets.
* Alert triage accuracy: low false\-positive closure rate and appropriate, timely escalations to L2\.
* Shift handoff quality: all open items documented and communicated clearly with no gaps.
* Demonstrated progression in GreyMatter proficiency and foundational tool knowledge over the first 90 days.
* Positive contribution to team knowledge through flagging repeat patterns and supporting runbook updates.


**WORKING CONDITIONS**
* 24×7 rotational shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays.
* On\-call support may be required for high\-severity incidents.
* Role demands sustained alertness, consistent process adherence, and composed, methodical work under pressure.
