title: Cyber Security Intern
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic and security\-minded
 **Cyber Security Intern** 
 to join our growing Information Security team. The ideal candidate should possess a strong foundation in networking, operating systems, and cybersecurity fundamentals, along with a passion for ethical hacking, penetration testing, and security research.
   

  

 This role is designed for candidates who aspire to build a long\-term career in Cyber Security and eventually grow into a
 **Cyber Security Subject Matter Expert (SME)** 
 . The intern will work closely with infrastructure teams, developers, and QA teams to identify vulnerabilities, improve security posture, and support information security initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Assist in Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) activities.
* Prepare security assessment reports and documentation.
* Perform security testing of web applications, APIs, networks, and wireless environments.
* Support security audits, risk assessments, and compliance initiatives.
* Monitor security alerts, logs, and incidents using security monitoring tools.
* Participate in incident investigation and root cause analysis activities.
* Conduct research on evolving cyber threats and attack techniques, translate findings into security improvements, and support proactive risk mitigation initiatives.
* Support secure coding and application security review activities.
* Collaborate with development, DevOps, QA, and infrastructure teams on security best practices.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree (or final\-year student) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Applications, or related field
* Strong understanding of Computer Networks, Operating Systems, and Security Fundamentals
* Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPNs, and Firewalls
* Basic understanding of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and common attack vectors
* Familiarity with Linux operating systems and command\-line usage
* Basic knowledge of scripting/programming using Python, JavaScript, Bash, or PowerShell
* Understanding of authentication, authorization, encryption, and cryptography concepts
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities
* Curiosity, self\-learning mindset, and strong attention to detail


**Preferred Certifications**
 Candidates with one or more of the following certifications or training programs will be preferred:
   

  

* Certificate of Completion – Cybersecurity \& Ethical Hacking
* WiFi Pentesting 101
* Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate V2
* Web Application Security Certification
* Cisco Cybersecurity Course / Cybersecurity Essentials
* Critical Infrastructure Protection
* Junior Penetration Tester (eJPT or equivalent)
* ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
* CompTIA Security\+ (Preferred)
* TryHackMe or Hack The Box Learning Paths


**Good to Have**
* Familiarity with security tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Wireshark, Metasploit, OWASP ZAP, or Nessus
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Participation in Capture The Flag (CTF) competitions or bug bounty programs
* Academic projects related to cybersecurity, networking, or ethical hacking
* Exposure to SIEM, SOC operations, or threat intelligence concepts
* Knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC)


**What We Offer**
* Opportunity to work on real\-world security assessments and client environments
* Hands\-on exposure to vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, cloud security, and security operations
* Learning and growth\-oriented environment with mentorship from experienced security professionals
* Exposure to modern cybersecurity practices, threat detection, and security automation technologies
* Defined career progression toward Security Analyst, Security Engineer, and Cyber Security SME roles
* Opportunity for full\-time employment based on performance

title: Cloud Security Analyst
description:
**Cloud Security Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research teams to build smarter, safer AI systems — and we need practitioners who truly understand how cloud environments fail in the real world.
   

  

 If you've spent time in the trenches of AWS, GCP, or Azure and you know what a misconfigured IAM policy or an exposed storage bucket actually means for a business, this role was built for you. Your expertise will directly shape how AI reasons about cloud security — making these systems more accurate, more realistic, and more useful.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Analyze cloud security scenarios across AWS, GCP, and Azure to identify risks and realistic failure patterns
* Review IAM configurations, network architectures, storage permissions, and container security setups
* Classify security gaps, misconfigurations, and cloud incidents based on real\-world impact and blast radius
* Validate and improve AI\-generated security reasoning so it reflects how cloud incidents actually unfold
* Help build datasets and evaluations that push the frontier of AI security capabilities


**Who You Are**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience working with cloud environments in production
* Solid understanding of cloud IAM, networking, storage, and container security across major providers
* Familiar with real\-world misconfigurations and how they escalate into incidents
* Able to reason clearly about blast radius, risk exposure, and business impact
* Self\-directed and comfortable working asynchronously on task\-based assignments


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with cloud security tooling (e.g., Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud, AWS Security Hub)
* Background in penetration testing, red teaming, or incident response
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, or NIST
* Security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CCSP, CISSP, etc.)


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly on frontier AI systems with top research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Meaningful work that improves how AI understands real\-world security
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Admissions Coordinator
description:
**Company:** Olive Ayurveda  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Job Role:** Admission Coordinator  
**Location:** Ernakulam  
**Experience:** 1–3 years preferred  
**Department:** Patient Coordination / Admissions / Customer Support

**About the Role:**

Olive Ayurveda is looking for a responsible, organized, and patient\-friendly **Admission Coordinator** to join our team on a full\-time basis.

The Admission Coordinator will be responsible for handling patient enquiries, coordinating admissions, managing leads in the lead management system, following up with prospective patients, and providing accurate information regarding consultations, treatments, medicines, IP admissions, courier status, and other services offered by Olive Ayurveda.

The person in this role will be an important communication point between **patients, doctors, therapists, administration, pharmacy, and other internal departments**. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, patience, a service\-oriented attitude, and the ability to manage multiple enquiries systematically.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Lead Management \& Follow\-Up**

* Manage and regularly update the **Lead Management System**.
* Receive and respond to patient enquiries generated through phone calls, WhatsApp, social media, website, advertisements, and other sources.
* Contact new leads promptly and understand their requirements.
* Follow up with prospective patients regarding consultations, treatments, admissions, and other services.
* Maintain accurate lead information, enquiry status, follow\-up details, and conversion status.
* Ensure that no genuine enquiry is missed or left without appropriate follow\-up.
* Coordinate with the concerned team members whenever a lead requires additional information.

**2\. Patient Communication \& Support**

* Communicate with patients and attendants in a polite, professional, and friendly manner.
* Understand patient requirements and provide clear information regarding available services.
* Answer routine patient queries and coordinate with the concerned department when medical clarification is required.
* Assist patients in understanding the consultation and admission process.
* Maintain proper communication with patients before, during, and after their visit/admission.
* Handle patient enquiries with patience, empathy, confidentiality, and professionalism.

**3\. Consultation Coordination**

* Provide patients with accurate information regarding **consultation locations, consultation procedures, timings, booking procedures, and availability**.
* Coordinate consultation appointments with the concerned doctor/team.
* Follow up with patients regarding scheduled consultations.
* Update consultation\-related information in the relevant system/register.
* Coordinate with the concerned department if there are changes in consultation schedules or arrangements.

**4\. IP Admission Coordination**

* Coordinate enquiries related to **In\-Patient (IP) admissions**.
* Explain the general admission procedure, requirements, available facilities, and other relevant information to patients.
* Collect and record necessary patient information for admission coordination.
* Coordinate with the concerned administration/reception/medical team regarding admission arrangements.
* Follow up with patients who have expressed interest in IP admission.
* Ensure smooth communication between the patient and the concerned departments.

**5\. Medicine \& Courier Support**

* Respond to patient enquiries regarding medicine orders and delivery.
* Check and communicate **medicine courier/order status** to patients.
* Coordinate with the pharmacy and dispatch team regarding pending or delayed orders.
* Provide patients with available tracking or dispatch information.
* Escalate delivery\-related issues to the concerned person and follow up until appropriate action is taken.
* Maintain proper records of medicine\-related enquiries and follow\-ups.

**6\. Olive Ayurveda Updates \& Information**

* Keep yourself updated about the latest **treatments, packages, services, consultation arrangements, admission procedures, special offers, health programs, and other updates of Olive Ayurveda**.
* Communicate relevant updates accurately to patients and prospective patients.
* Ensure that outdated information is not communicated to patients.
* Coordinate with management to obtain clarification whenever required.

**7\. Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate effectively with:
* Doctors and Medical Team
* Reception / Front Office
* Pharmacy
* Administration
* Accounts
* Therapy / Treatment Team
* Marketing \& Lead Generation Team
* Dispatch / Courier Team
* Forward enquiries to the appropriate department when necessary.
* Maintain proper communication and follow\-up until the patient's requirement is addressed.

**8\. Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, enquiries, follow\-ups, consultations, admissions, and other patient communications.
* Update the lead management system on a daily basis.
* Prepare or assist in preparing daily/weekly enquiry and admission reports.
* Track lead follow\-ups and pending enquiries.
* Report important issues, complaints, or unresolved patient requirements to the concerned reporting manager.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient and organizational information.

**Additional Responsibilities**

The Admission Coordinator may also be required to:

* Handle WhatsApp and telephone enquiries.
* Coordinate online and offline appointment requests.
* Follow up with patients who have not confirmed their consultation/admission.
* Assist patients with basic information about Olive Ayurveda's services.
* Coordinate special treatment/package enquiries.
* Support patient registration and documentation processes.
* Handle patient feedback and forward it to the appropriate authority.
* Assist the management team in maintaining smooth patient communication.
* Perform other related coordination responsibilities assigned by the reporting manager.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent **communication and interpersonal skills**.
* Good spoken and written **English and Malayalam**.
* Hindi or other Indian languages will be an added advantage.
* Good telephone etiquette and professional communication.
* Strong follow\-up skills.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple enquiries simultaneously.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Ability to use **Google Sheets, Google Workspace, WhatsApp, email, and CRM/lead management systems**.
* Good data\-entry and documentation skills.
* Ability to learn new software and systems quickly.
* Patient, polite, and service\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work as part of a team.
* Good problem\-solving and coordination skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification preferred.
* Previous experience in **hospital, Ayurveda, healthcare, wellness, clinic, customer support, front office, admissions, tele\-calling, CRM, or patient coordination** will be an advantage.
* Experience handling leads, patient enquiries, appointments, admissions, or customer support is preferred.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills and a willingness to learn may also be considered.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone who:

* Enjoys communicating with people and helping patients.
* Can patiently listen to patient concerns and provide appropriate assistance.
* Takes ownership of enquiries and follows them through to completion.
* Is comfortable working with computers and digital systems.
* Can maintain accurate records without missing important details.
* Can coordinate effectively with multiple departments.
* Is punctual, disciplined, responsible, and professional.
* Can maintain patient confidentiality.
* Is willing to learn about Ayurveda services and Olive Ayurveda's processes.
* Can work in a fast\-paced healthcare/service environment.

**Performance Expectations**

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Maintain timely lead follow\-ups.
* Keep the lead management system updated accurately.
* Ensure patient enquiries receive appropriate responses.
* Coordinate consultations and admissions efficiently.
* Provide accurate information to patients.
* Maintain proper records and reports.
* Escalate unresolved issues promptly.
* Contribute to a positive patient experience.

**Employment Details**

**Position:** Admission Coordinator  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time

title: Marketing Intern – Social Media, Content & Lead Generation
description:
This is a **Marketing Intern** role: find where buyers already are, post trend\-based content that sells AltheaBit’s software services, run small ads, and turn attention into real leads.

**Company:**AltheaBit

**Type:** Internship

**Location:** Remote

**Schedule:** Flexible

AltheaBit builds websites, web apps, mobile apps, backend APIs, cloud solutions, and business automation for startups and businesses. We need an intern who can market these services the way companies actually get clients today: short videos, social posts, trend\-based content, ads, and daily follow\-up — not only cold calls.

**What you will do**

\- Find where potential clients spend time: Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, Google, and relevant communities, groups, and comment sections.

\- Create and post short videos (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and similar) tied to what is trending now, but always aimed at selling our services. Examples: “We built this app in X weeks,” client problem → our solution, website before/after, founder clips, and “what this costs / who it is for.”

\- Write captions, carousels, and posts that explain our work in simple language and ask people to enquire (DM, WhatsApp, form, or call).

\- Reply to comments and DMs the same day, qualify the lead (what they need, budget range, timeline), and pass serious enquiries to the founding team.

\- Help set up and run small paid ads on Instagram/Facebook and Google (with the team’s approval): audience, creative, budget, and which ads bring enquiries.

\- Keep a simple tracker: what was posted, where, views, DMs, leads, and meetings booked.

\- Watch competitors and current formats (hooks, trends, hashtags) and test 2–3 content ideas each week.

\- Support the founding team on proposals and follow\-ups once a lead is interested.

**Who should apply**

\- fresher who can work independently and show work every week.

\- Comfortable on camera, or able to edit talking\-head and screen\-recording videos (CapCut, Canva, or similar is enough).

\- Has posted regularly on Instagram, LinkedIn, or YouTube, or can show sample posts/reels.

\- Can write clear English (and a local language if you use it with clients).

\- Understands that the goal is enquiries and clients, not only likes.

\- Prior sales or marketing internship is useful, not required. A small portfolio of posts or videos matters more.

**What we offer**

\- Direct work with the founding team.

\- Ownership of the social and content pipeline from day one.

\- Exposure to real client projects and international work.

\- Learning on ads, content, and how software services are sold.

\- Performance\-based incentive if your content or ads produce qualified leads.

\- Flexible, remote internship.

**How to apply**

Apply at https://altheabit.com/careers.

In your application, include:

1\. 2–3 links to posts or videos you made (or a short sample Reel about any product).

2\. One paragraph on how you would get the first 10 enquiries for a software company with no big ad budget.

**What “good” looks like in the first month**

\- A weekly content calendar and at least 4–5 posts, including short videos.

\- A list of target customer types and the platforms they use.

\- A lead sheet with every DM, comment, and form enquiry.

\- One small ad test and a note on what worked.

\- Qualified leads handed to the founding team, not just vanity metrics.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

  

Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

  

Team Collaboration* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

  

Qualifications \& Experience:
Education:* Minimum 8th Standard Pass.

Experience:* Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

  

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.

description:
**Role: Mobile Developer (Flutter) – Broker\-Tech / Trading Domain** 




 Location: Mumbai, India
 



 Experience: 3 – 6 Years
 



 Domain: FinTech / Broker\-Tech / Capital Markets
 



  





**Role Summary:** 




 We are looking for an experienced Flutter Developer with hands\-on experience in the Broker\-Tech / Financial Trading domain. In this role, you will design, build, and optimize high\-performance mobile trading platforms across iOS and Android. You will work directly with low\-latency streaming market data, order routing workflows, portfolio systems, and strict security compliance to deliver a seamless, real\-time trading experience.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 




  





 \- Core App Development: Build and scale responsive, pixel\-perfect cross\-platform mobile apps using Flutter and Dart tailored for equities, derivatives, commodities, or forex trading.
 



 \- Real\-time Data Streaming: Integrate WebSocket/TCP socket feeds to handle high\-frequency market data streaming (Ticker, Depth/L2 data, Order Book) with minimal latency.
 



 \- Backend \& System Integration: Interface securely with trading backend systems including Order Management Systems (OMS), Risk Management Systems (RMS), Back\-Office systems, and partner/broker APIs.
 



 \- Feature Delivery: Implement core trading workflows such as single/multi\-leg order placement (Market, Limit, SL, Bracket Orders), live portfolio tracking, P\&L reporting, interactive charting, and market scanners.
 



 \- Performance \& Speed: Optimize rendering performance (aiming for consistent 60/120 FPS), memory management, build size, and app launch times on mid\-to\-low\-end mobile hardware.
 



 \- Security \& Compliance: Enforce mobile security standards including biometric authentication (FaceID/Fingerprint), 2FA/TOTP, token storage encryption, SSL/TLS pinning, and root/jailbreak detection.
 



 \- Cross\-functional Collaboration: Partner with product managers, UI/UX designers, backend devs, and quantitative/risk teams to translate complex trading mechanics into intuitive UI workflows.
 



 \- Quality \& Stability: Write clean, testable code (Unit, Widget, and Integration tests), perform memory profiling, and resolve production crashes proactively.
 



  





**Technical \& Domain Requirements:** 




  





**Must\-Haves:** 




  





 \- Experience: 3–6 years of professional software development, with 2\+ years of dedicated Flutter/Dart experience delivering production\-grade applications.
 



 \- Domain Expertise: Practical understanding of trading domain concepts (Market Data, Order Types, Market Depth, Margin calculation, Positions, Holdings, Ledger, and Contract Notes).
 



 \- Real\-time Protocols: Demonstrated experience handling WebSockets, Server\-Sent Events (SSE), or socket connections for real\-time feed updates in Flutter.
 



 \- State Management: Mastery of scalable architecture and state management solutions (specifically BLoC or Riverpod) to manage complex UI state changes.
 



 \- API Integration: Proficiency in RESTful APIs, JSON parsing, secure OAuth2/JWT authentication flows, and dynamic payload handling.
 



 \- Version Control \& CI/CD: Strong expertise with Git workflows (feature branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution).
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Haves:** 




  





 \- Familiarity with financial charting libraries (e.g., TradingView integration, custom Canvas drawing for stock charts).
 



 \- Understanding of native mobile bridges (MethodChannels) for iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin).
 



 \- Prior experience with app store deployment cycles (Google Play Console and Apple App Store Connect) and automated build pipelines (CI/CD).

title: Solution Sales Engineer – IIoT
description:
**About the Role** 




 Are you a passionate and dynamic graduate engineer looking to build an exciting career in sales and marketing within the fast\-growing world of Industrial IoT (IIoT) and Digitalization? If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you! We are looking for talented and energetic engineers to join our Sales \& Marketing team and become specialists in IIoT and digital transformation solution sales for IIoTNext. In this role, you will drive sales and business development activities for Consyst’s IIoTNext platform products and solutions, helping industries and infrastructure businesses connect, monitor, and optimize their operations.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 You will be at the front line of our IIoTNext growth story. Working closely with our pre\-sales and marketing teams, you will generate new leads, reach out to prospects through cold calls and digital channels, and respond to customer enquiries and RFQs. You’ll have the exciting opportunity to conduct product demos and presentations – both virtual and face\-to\-face – where you will show customers how IIoTNext solutions solve their real\-world challenges in digitalization, remote monitoring, and data\-driven decision making. You will also support our digital marketing efforts to build the IIoTNext brand and reach customers in both local and overseas markets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Generate new leads and build a healthy sales pipeline for IIoTNext through proactive prospecting, cold calling, emails, and networking.
* Reach out to potential customers across local and overseas markets, identifying new opportunities in the IIoT and digitalization space.
* Conduct engaging product demonstrations and presentations – virtual and face\-to\-face – clearly showing how IIoTNext solutions meet each customer’s needs.
* Build strong and lasting relationships with key customers, including Partners, End Users and OEMs, and communicate effectively with key decision\-makers.
* Support the digital marketing team with content, campaigns, and follow\-ups to promote IIoTNext and attract new leads online.
* Assist in preparing and submitting proposals and quotations for each opportunity, showcasing the value of our IIoT solutions.
* Meet and exceed regular sales targets, continuously improving the sales pipeline through proactive lead generation and conversion efforts.
* Collaborate closely with the pre\-sales and backend support teams to tailor the right IIoT solution to each customer’s unique requirements.
* Maintain precise and up\-to\-date sales data, updating all relevant information into our CRM/ERP system.
* Work in tandem with the sales lead to implement effective sales and marketing strategies for both local and overseas markets.



  





**Professional Qualifications and Personal Attributes** 



* A bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronics, instrumentation, engineering is required.
* 0 – 1 year of experience in IIoT / Digitalization / Industrial Automation solution sales. Fresh graduates with a strong interest in technology sales are welcome to apply.
* A strong desire to build a career in sales, with the confidence to make cold calls and meet new customers.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills to clearly explain our IIoT solutions and conduct product demos.
* Comfortable using digital tools, social media, and online platforms to support marketing and outreach.
* Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is necessary to articulate ideas clearly and professionally. Knowledge of additional languages is an advantage for overseas sales.
* Willingness to engage with customers in both local and international markets.



  





**Location:** 
 Cochin (with a focus on both domestic and overseas sales)
 



 At Consyst, we believe in nurturing talent and fostering a collaborative work environment that promotes growth and innovation. If you are ready to take the next step in your career and make a real impact in the exciting world of IIoT and Digitalization with IIoTNext, we encourage you to apply today!

title: Engineer - Robotics & Control
description:
**ABOUT AGRATAS** 




 Agratas is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons. We design, develop and manufacture high\-quality, high\-performance, sustainable batteries applied to multiple use cases in the mobility and energy sectors, to match our customers’ requirements.
 



 Agratas is a scale\-up business with a start\-up mentality, driven by our pursuit of green growth and technological progress.
 



 We develop next\-generation battery technologies at our state\-of\-the\-art R\&D Innovation Hubs in India and the UK.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We are seeking a
 **Robotics Engineer** 
 to join our team in the
 **Battery Manufacturing Industry** 
 . In this role, you will play a critical part in enhancing and automating our manufacturing processes using state\-of\-the\-art robotics technology. You will have the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge automation projects, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and contribute to optimizing our production efficiency. This position will offer you a chance to grow professionally in a fast\-paced, high\-tech environment and have a significant impact on the future of energy storage solutions.
 



  





  





 Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities
 



  




* **Robotics System Design \& Development:** 
 Lead the design, development, and implementation of robotic automation systems for battery manufacturing, including assembly, testing, and packaging processes.
* **Vendor Management:** 
 Manage relationships with robotic system suppliers and automation service providers. Oversee the evaluation, procurement, and performance monitoring of robotic systems and solutions to ensure they meet project requirements and timelines.
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (engineering, production, senior management) to align project goals, timelines, and deliverables. Engage external stakeholders as required for seamless implementation of robotics and automation projects.
* **Technical Documentation:** 
 Design and develop detailed specifications, manuals, and all relevant documentation related to robotic systems. Ensure these documents remain updated throughout the system lifecycle.
* **Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT):** 
 Plan, coordinate, and execute FAT to verify the functionality of robotic systems and equipment before installation. Ensure that all systems meet design and performance specifications.
* **Site Acceptance Testing (SAT):** 
 Oversee SAT at the manufacturing site, ensuring that the robotic systems perform as expected within the live environment and resolve any operational issues as they arise.
* **System Integration:** 
 Integrate new robotic systems into existing manufacturing lines and ensure their seamless operation within current workflows.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Monitor robotic system performance and provide recommendations for system and process optimizations.
* **Safety \& Compliance:** 
 Ensure all robotics and automation systems comply with safety regulations, quality assurance processes, and industry\-specific regulatory requirements.



  





 Knowledge, Skills and Experience
 



  




* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation \& Control Engineering, , Mechatronics, or a related technical field. Master’s degree or certifications in automation systems is a plus.
* Strong technical knowledge of robotics, automation, and control systems (e.g., ABB, KUKA, FANUC robots).
* Programming expertise in languages such as Python, C\+\+, ROS, and PLC systems for the control of robotic systems.
* Project management experience with a track record of successfully managing complex automation projects, including scheduling, budgeting, and resource allocation.
* Experience in vendor and stakeholder management, including contract negotiations and ensuring suppliers meet quality and performance expectations.
* Understanding of manufacturing processes, particularly in battery production, assembly, and packaging.
* Problem\-solving abilities with a hands\-on approach to troubleshooting and improving robotic systems.
* Familiarity with Industry 4\.0 technologies like IoT, AI, and machine learning for advanced manufacturing applications



  





 Role Specific Qualifications/Certifications
 



  




* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* Certification in Robotics or Automation Systems is highly desirable.
* Experience with advanced robotics technologies such as vision systems, machine learning algorithms, or AI\-powered automation is a plus.
* Knowledge of battery manufacturing processes or similar high\-precision production environments is beneficial.

title: Applications Engineer
description:
**About TOMRA Food:**




 TOMRA Food is a multinational organization and a leading provider of sensor\-based sorting, peeling and integrated post\-harvest solution for the food industries. Transforming global food production to maximize food safety and minimize food loss by making sure
 **Every Resource Counts™** 
 , has been our strength for over 50 years.
   

  





 At TOMRA, we want people to
 **innovate** 
 , show
 **passion** 
 in their work and be
 **responsible** 
 . We encourage the freedom to innovate and take risks that result in breakthroughs that challenge the status quo. We value passion that focuses and commits to meeting success. We believe in a responsible and safe mindset that takes care of our customers, products, and fellow employees.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Your Opportunity**




**This is not a traditional office\-based engineering role.**




 As an Applications Engineer, you will join TOMRA Food's Sales Applications Support Engineering (SASE) team, serving as the technical bridge between our customers and sales teams. You will play a critical role in helping customers identify industry\-leading sorting solutions for their processing challenges while maximizing the value of TOMRA's technology.
   

  





 You will work at the intersection of engineering, customer success, sales, service, and projects. From leading customer demonstrations and trials to commissioning equipment, analyzing performance results, and troubleshooting complex technical challenges, you will play a key role in helping customers unlock the full potential of TOMRA's solutions. Along the way, you'll gain hands\-on experience with industry\-leading sorting technologies, software interfaces, sensors, lasers, electronics, and mechanical systems.
   

  





 We're looking for an engineer who enjoys working closely with customers, thrives in a hands\-on environment, and can adapt seamlessly between technical, commercial, and operational challenges. If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving problems, and are motivated by helping customers achieve successful outcomes, you'll have the opportunity to build expertise in industry\-leading sorting technologies while supporting customers from our Bangalore Demonstration Facility and across Southeast Asia and the wider APAC region.
   

  





 Fluency in written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in additional Indian languages would be advantageous.
   

  





  

  





**What You'll Be Doing**





 Own Customer Trials \& Demonstrations
   

  





* Partner closely with customers to understand their processing challenges, production requirements, and desired outcomes
* Lead product demonstrations and customer trials at TOMRA's Bangalore Demo Facility and customer sites across India and the APAC region
* Analyze performance data and present trial results, recommendations, and business outcomes to customers
* Establish efficiencies, product quality outcomes, defect reduction metrics, and performance benchmarks through technical analysis
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers evaluate applications, validate results, and maximize the value of TOMRA's technology




 Become a Technical Subject Matter Expert
   

  





* Develop deep expertise across TOMRA's sorting technologies, software interfaces, sensors, optics, lasers, electronics, and mechanical systems
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers understand application performance, validate business outcomes, and confidently adopt TOMRA solutions
* Support customers and internal teams with technical recommendations, troubleshooting, and application expertise
* Utilize software tools and user interfaces to optimize machine performance, analyze results, and support customer applications
* Continuously develop your knowledge across food processing applications, emerging technologies, and TOMRA product solutions




 Commission \& Optimize Equipment
   

  





* Travel to customer sites across India and the APAC region to commission equipment and ensure successful installations
* Support performance verification, startup activities, and customer acceptance testing
* Troubleshoot software, electronic, and mechanical issues to identify root causes and restore performance
* Assist customers in maximizing sorting performance, product quality, and operational efficiency




 Partner Across Multiple Functions
   

  





* Work closely with Sales, Service, Project Management, and Customers
* Support equipment selection and application development activities
* Provide technical expertise throughout the customer journey, from initial trial through final installation and optimization




 Support Continuous Improvement
   

  





* Gather customer feedback and field insights to support future product development
* Contribute to technical documentation, reports, and training material
* Share knowledge across regional and global teams



  

  





**What Success Looks Like**



* Embrace a highly customer\-facing role and enjoy being the technical expert customers trust throughout trials, commissioning, optimization, and support activities
* Are excited by travel and thrive in a dynamic environment, spending approximately 60% of their time supporting customers across India and the APAC region
* Are comfortable spending 2\-3 weeks per month travelling to customer sites for demonstrations, commissioning, troubleshooting, training, and project support
* Can commit to working 6 days onsite out of our Bangalore Office \& demonstration lab
* Confidently translates technical data, performance results, and complex engineering concepts into meaningful outcomes for customers
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities and can move seamlessly between customer trials, commissioning activities, technical troubleshooting, and project support
* Bring curiosity, initiative, and a problem\-solving mindset to every customer challenge, helping customers maximize the value of TOMRA's technology
* Ability to work in Food processing plants, farms, cold storage facilities, and outside in high/low temperatures



  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**We're Looking For**



* 4\+ years of engineering experience within industrial equipment, automation, machinery, process industries, food processing, sorting technology, or related sectors
* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Have a strong technical foundation in one or more of the following areas: electronics, electrical systems, sensors, instrumentation, controls, automation, software interfaces, lasers, vision systems, or mechatronics
* Excellent communication skills and customer engagement abilities
* Experience working directly with customers in technical or field\-based environments
* Experience presenting technical solutions and concepts to customers and internal teams
* Willingness to travel 60% of the time across India and the APAC region internationally
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical capabilities
* Ability to interpret performance data and translate findings into actionable recommendations
* Prior experience with optical sorting, food sorting, grading systems, automation equipment, or industrial machinery
* Experience commissioning, servicing, or troubleshooting field equipment
* Knowledge of sensors, electronics, industrial software, PLCs, controls, lasers, vision systems, or automation technologies
* Fluent spoken and written English; proficiency in additional Indian languages is advantageous
* Strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships both internally and externally
* No major food allergies that would impede ability to work around or near food, nuts, fruits, and vegetables


**Additional Information**

 If you don't meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. At TOMRA, we recognize that diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. All applications will be managed in the strictest confidence.
   

  





 TOMRA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristics. Reasonable accommodations will be made and will be provided as requested by candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Content Creator
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONContent Creator

**Company:** The Digital Zilla  
**Location:** Jalandhar, Punjab  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  
**Department:** Content \& Social Media  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month, depending on skills and experience

About The Role

The Digital Zilla is looking for a **creative, confident, and trend\-aware Content Creator** who can turn ideas, brands, products, services, and people into engaging digital content.

The candidate should be comfortable with **content research, scripting, shooting, presenting, and creating social\-media content**, especially Instagram Reels and short\-form videos.

This role is ideal for someone who understands what makes people **stop scrolling, watch, engage, and share**.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate fresh and creative content ideas for different clients and industries.
* Research trending topics, Reels formats, hooks, sounds, concepts, and social\-media trends.
* Write scripts, hooks, captions, and content concepts.
* Create content for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts and other digital platforms.
* Participate in and, when required, **appear in front of the camera** for Reels and promotional content.
* Coordinate and conduct client shoots along with the production/video team.
* Shoot basic videos using smartphones/cameras with proper framing, lighting and composition.
* Create different types of content including:
* Reels
* Talking\-head videos
* Educational videos
* Promotional videos
* Product/service videos
* Trend\-based content
* Founder/personal\-brand content
* Behind\-the\-scenes content
* Customer\-focused content
* Develop strong hooks and storytelling structures to improve viewer retention.
* Work with video editors, graphic designers, social media managers and account managers.
* Understand each client's target audience and create content accordingly.
* Maintain consistency in brand tone, messaging and visual style.
* Review published content and suggest improvements based on engagement and performance.
* Stay updated with Instagram and YouTube trends, formats and content styles.

Required Skills

* Strong creativity and idea\-generation ability.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Good command of English and Hindi/Punjabi.
* Strong understanding of Instagram Reels and short\-form content.
* Good scripting and copywriting skills.
* Understanding of hooks, storytelling and audience psychology.
* Comfortable speaking on camera.
* Basic knowledge of mobile photography/videography.
* Ability to research and understand different industries quickly.
* Good knowledge of current social\-media trends.
* Ability to work on multiple clients and meet deadlines.
* Basic knowledge of Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar tools is an advantage.

Preferred Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Confident in front of the camera**
* Naturally creative and full of content ideas
* Comfortable visiting client locations for shoots
* Active on Instagram/YouTube and aware of current trends
* Good at communicating with clients and team members
* Willing to experiment with new content formats
* Able to work in a fast\-paced digital marketing agency
* More focused on **creating content that performs** rather than simply completing assigned posts

Qualifications

A degree/diploma in **Mass Communication, Journalism, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Media, or a related field** is preferred but not mandatory.

**Freshers with a strong portfolio, personal Instagram/YouTube page, or relevant content\-creation experience can also apply.**

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with multiple brands and industries.
* Exposure to real client projects.
* Experience in social media, content strategy and digital marketing.
* Opportunity to participate in professional shoots.
* Creative and collaborative work environment.
* Growth opportunities within the organisation.

How To Apply

Interested candidates can share their **resume \+ portfolio/Instagram profile \+ examples of their previous content** with the HR team.

**Location:** The Digital Zilla, Jalandhar  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site

Pay: ₹10,148\.14 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

description:
**Experience:** 0–2 years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** \[Location / Hybrid / Remote]  
**Department:** Creative / Design  
**Reports To:** Senior Graphic Designer / Creative Lead

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **Junior Graphic Designer** to join our design team. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of visual communication, typography, layouts, color theory, and brand aesthetics, along with an interest in creating engaging content for social media and digital platforms.

This role is suitable for **freshers as well as candidates with up to 2 years of professional experience**. We value strong design fundamentals, creativity, attention to detail, willingness to learn, and the ability to translate ideas into visually compelling designs.

The role will involve creating **social media creatives, digital marketing assets, campaign visuals, brand collateral, presentations, and other graphic design requirements**.

We believe in design driven by creativity and craft. **Strong manual design skills are important, and AI\-generated artwork should not be relied upon as a substitute for core graphic design ability.**

Key ResponsibilitiesGraphic Design

* Create visually appealing and on\-brand designs for digital and offline communication.
* Develop social media creatives for platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, and other relevant channels.
* Design static posts, carousels, stories, reels covers, thumbnails, banners, ads, and other digital assets.
* Assist in developing creative concepts and visual directions for campaigns.
* Work with existing brand guidelines to maintain consistency across all communication.
* Create marketing collateral such as brochures, flyers, posters, presentations, emailers, digital banners, and promotional material.
* Adapt existing designs into different sizes and formats while maintaining visual consistency.
* Work with typography, imagery, illustrations, icons, shapes, colors, and layouts effectively.
* Prepare artwork according to platform, digital, and print specifications.
* Make design revisions based on feedback from the creative, marketing, or content teams.
* Organize design files and maintain clean, editable, and properly structured source files.

Social Media Creatives

* Create engaging and visually consistent content for social media campaigns.
* Translate content, briefs, concepts, and marketing messages into effective visual communication.
* Design creative assets based on social media trends while ensuring they remain aligned with the brand identity.
* Understand basic differences in creative requirements across platforms.
* Create multiple creative variations for campaigns, advertisements, announcements, promotions, and events.
* Collaborate with content writers and social media managers to develop cohesive visual \+ copy combinations.
* Stay updated with evolving design trends, social media formats, visual styles, and digital content trends.

Collaboration \& Execution

* Understand creative briefs and ask relevant questions when requirements are unclear.
* Work closely with marketing, social media, content, and other internal teams.
* Manage multiple design requests and meet agreed timelines.
* Be receptive to feedback and implement revisions efficiently.
* Take ownership of assigned design tasks from brief to final delivery.
* Participate in brainstorming and contribute creative ideas to campaigns and projects.
* Maintain a well\-organized library of design assets, templates, fonts, images, and source files.

Required SkillsDesign Fundamentals

A good understanding of the following is expected:

* Composition and layout
* Typography
* Color theory
* Visual hierarchy
* Spacing and alignment
* Image selection and treatment
* Branding and visual consistency
* Basic principles of visual communication
* Creative conceptualization
* Attention to detail

Design Software

Proficiency in relevant professional design tools is expected, particularly:

* **Adobe Photoshop**
* **Adobe Illustrator**
* **Adobe InDesign** — basic to intermediate knowledge
* **Figma** — basic to intermediate knowledge

Familiarity with additional tools such as **Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Canva, or other relevant creative software** will be an advantage.

Candidates should be comfortable selecting the appropriate software depending on the design requirement.

AI Usage

We prefer candidates with **strong foundational graphic design skills and minimal dependence on AI\-generated design assets**.

AI tools may be used selectively for appropriate supporting tasks such as ideation, research, organization, or workflow assistance, but candidates should be capable of independently:

* Developing visual concepts
* Creating layouts
* Editing and manipulating images
* Working with typography
* Creating vector graphics
* Building social media creatives
* Following brand guidelines
* Making design decisions
* Preparing final artwork

**AI should complement the designer's skills, not replace them.**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates from other educational backgrounds with a strong design portfolio are also welcome.
* **Freshers are encouraged to apply.**
* Candidates with **up to 2 years of relevant experience** are welcome.
* Internship, freelance, college, or personal design project experience can be considered relevant for freshers.

Portfolio Requirements

A portfolio is **required** and will be an important part of the selection process.

The portfolio should ideally demonstrate:

* Social media creatives
* Branding or visual identity work
* Typography and layout
* Posters or campaign creatives
* Digital advertisements/banners
* Image editing/compositing
* Illustrations or vector artwork
* Creative concepts or campaign work

For freshers, **college projects, personal projects, freelance work, internships, or self\-initiated projects are completely acceptable**.

We are more interested in the candidate's **design thinking, fundamentals, creativity, and execution quality** than the number of years of experience.

Preferred Qualities

* Strong visual sense and creative thinking
* Good attention to detail
* Willingness to learn and experiment
* Ability to take and implement feedback
* Good understanding of current design and social media trends
* Ability to work independently as well as within a team
* Good time\-management and organizational skills
* Ability to handle multiple assignments and deadlines
* Strong sense of ownership
* Good communication skills
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for design

What We Look For

We are looking for someone who:

* Has a genuine interest in graphic design.
* Can explain the thinking behind their designs.
* Understands that good design is more than simply making something look attractive.
* Has strong fundamentals in typography, layout, color, and composition.
* Can create original designs rather than relying heavily on templates.
* Is comfortable experimenting with different visual styles.
* Can turn a written brief into a clear visual concept.
* Understands the importance of consistency in branding.
* Is willing to learn, accept feedback, and improve continuously.

What You Will Work On

Depending on business requirements, your work may include:

* Instagram posts and carousels
* Instagram stories
* LinkedIn creatives
* Social media campaign creatives
* Digital advertisements
* Promotional banners
* Website graphics
* Email creatives
* Event creatives
* Presentation decks
* Posters and flyers
* Brochures and marketing collateral
* Brand assets
* Campaign key visuals
* YouTube/social media thumbnails
* Basic motion graphics or video assets, if required

Performance Expectations

During the first few months, the candidate will be expected to:

* Understand and follow the company's visual identity and brand guidelines.
* Produce clean, accurate, and visually engaging designs.
* Deliver assigned creatives within agreed timelines.
* Demonstrate improvement based on feedback.
* Build familiarity with the company's products, audience, and communication style.
* Develop the ability to independently execute routine design requirements.
* Maintain organized and editable working files.

Why Join Us

* Opportunity to work on real\-world brand and marketing projects.
* Exposure to social media, digital marketing, branding, and campaign design.
* Opportunity to work closely with creative and marketing teams.
* Scope to develop and strengthen professional design skills.
* Opportunity for freshers to build practical industry experience.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Quality Executive
description:
**Position:** Quality Executive  
**Department:** Quality Assurance / Quality Control  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Jamnagar, Gujarat

Job Summary

We are looking for a **Quality Executive** to monitor and maintain product quality throughout the manufacturing process. The candidate will be responsible for incoming, in\-process, and final inspection, identifying quality issues, maintaining inspection records, and coordinating with production to ensure products meet customer specifications and company quality standards.

**Freshers with relevant technical knowledge may also be considered.**

Key Responsibilities

* Perform **incoming, in\-process, and final inspection** of manufactured components.
* Inspect brass components, CNC/automatic lathe parts, precision turned components, fittings, and other engineering components.
* Read and understand **engineering drawings, specifications, tolerances, and inspection standards**.
* Perform dimensional and visual inspection using:
* Vernier Caliper
* Micrometer
* Thread Gauges
* Plug Gauges
* Ring Gauges
* Height Gauge
* Bore Gauge
* Other measuring instruments
* Conduct first\-piece inspection and verify production samples before regular production.
* Monitor quality during production and identify defects at an early stage.
* Identify, record, and segregate rejected/non\-conforming material.
* Coordinate with Production and Line Inspectors to resolve quality issues.
* Maintain inspection reports, rejection reports, and other quality records.
* Ensure proper identification and traceability of inspected batches.
* Monitor recurring defects and support **root\-cause analysis and corrective actions**.
* Support implementation of CAPA and continuous improvement activities.
* Check that products are manufactured according to approved drawings and customer requirements.
* Monitor and report internal rejection, rework, and scrap.
* Assist in customer complaint investigation and corrective action preparation.
* Support calibration and proper handling of measuring instruments.
* Assist the Quality Manager during internal, customer, and third\-party audits.
* Prepare basic quality reports and MIS for management.
* Follow company quality procedures, work instructions, and safety requirements.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of **engineering drawings and dimensional inspection**.
* Understanding of tolerances, limits, fits, and basic GD\&T.
* Practical knowledge of measuring instruments and gauges.
* Basic knowledge of CNC/automatic machining processes.
* Knowledge of quality tools such as **5 Why, Fishbone Analysis, 7 QC Tools, CAPA, and basic SPC** is preferred.
* Good observation and problem\-solving skills.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office.

Qualification

* **ITI / Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Quality, or related field.**
* **1–3 years of experience** in Quality Control / Quality Assurance preferred.
* Experience in **brass, CNC, precision machining, automatic lathe, fittings, Valve or engineering components** will be an advantage.
* **Freshers may also apply** if they have relevant technical knowledge and a willingness to learn.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Inspection accuracy and effectiveness.
* Reduction in internal rejection and rework.
* Timely identification of quality issues.
* Compliance with drawings and customer specifications.
* Accuracy and timely completion of quality records.
* Timely closure of quality issues and CAPA.
* Reduction in customer complaints.
* Proper control and traceability of non\-conforming material.
* Support for continuous quality improvement.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment

description:
Position: Insurance Advisor / Life Insurance Agent

Company: Bharti AXA Life Insurance

Department: Agency / Sales

Reporting To: Development Manager

Employment Type: Part\-Time / Full\-Time / Commission\-Based

About the Role

We are looking for motivated and customer\-oriented individuals to join Bharti AXA Life Insurance as Insurance Advisors. The Insurance Advisor will be responsible for identifying prospective customers, understanding their financial protection and insurance requirements, explaining suitable life insurance solutions, and building long\-term relationships with customers.

The role provides an opportunity to develop a career in the life insurance and financial\-services sector while working under the guidance and support of a Development Manager.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Customer Acquisition and Business Development

Identify and develop new prospective customers through personal networks, references, local contacts, and other legitimate business\-development activities.

Generate leads and arrange meetings with prospective customers.

Understand customers' financial protection, savings, retirement, and insurance requirements.

Develop and maintain a healthy customer prospect pipeline.

Work towards achieving assigned business and sales objectives.

2\. Insurance Product Presentation

Explain relevant life insurance products, benefits, policy features, premium\-payment options, exclusions, and applicable terms to customers.

Provide information accurately and transparently and help customers understand the product before making a purchase decision.

Assist customers in selecting products appropriate to their stated requirements, subject to company guidelines and eligibility.

3\. Customer Relationship Management

Maintain regular contact with existing customers.

Provide appropriate assistance regarding policy\-related queries and service requirements.

Develop long\-term relationships and encourage customer retention.

Generate business through customer references and referrals where appropriate.

4\. Documentation and Policy Processing

Assist customers in completing proposal forms and submitting the required documents.

Ensure that information provided in proposal forms is accurate and complete.

Coordinate with the company for medical requirements, underwriting information, policy issuance, and other necessary documentation.

Follow all company procedures relating to Know Your Customer (KYC), documentation, and policy processing.

5\. After\-Sales Service

Help customers understand their policy documents and important policy conditions.

Coordinate with the appropriate company channels for service requests, policy changes, premium\-related queries, and claims\-related assistance.

Maintain regular communication with customers regarding their policy servicing requirements.

6\. Compliance and Ethical Conduct

Follow Bharti AXA Life Insurance's rules, procedures, and code of conduct.

Follow applicable insurance regulations and guidelines issued by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI).

Never make false promises or misrepresent policy benefits, returns, charges, exclusions, or other terms.

Maintain confidentiality of customer information and documents.

Training and Support

The selected Insurance Advisor will receive guidance from the Development Manager, including:

Product and process training.

Sales and customer\-handling training.

Assistance with prospecting and lead generation.

Guidance on conducting customer meetings and presentations.

Regular performance reviews and business\-development support.

Guidance regarding licensing, examinations, and regulatory requirements applicable to insurance agents.

Candidate Profile

Candidates should preferably have:

Good communication and interpersonal skills.

A customer\-oriented approach.

Ability to build and maintain professional relationships.

Basic understanding of financial products and willingness to learn.

Ability to work independently and manage a customer/prospect network.

Positive attitude and willingness to achieve business objectives.

Experience: Freshers as well as experienced candidates may be considered, subject to applicable eligibility and licensing requirements.

Preferred Qualities

Good communication skills

Confidence in interacting with customers

Networking ability

Sales and relationship\-building skills

Self\-motivation

Professional attitude

Willingness to learn

Local market knowledge and community contacts can be an advantage

Career Opportunity

The position can provide an opportunity to build a professional career in the life\-insurance sector. Advisors can develop their customer base, improve their sales and financial\-services knowledge, and progress through applicable company and regulatory career structures.

Important Note

The exact commission structure, incentives, benefits, eligibility criteria, licensing requirements, and appointment terms will be as per the prevailing company policy and applicable IRDAI regulations.

title: Content Creator
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONContent Creator

**Company:** The Digital Zilla  
**Location:** Jalandhar, Punjab  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  
**Department:** Content \& Social Media  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month, depending on skills and experience

About The Role

The Digital Zilla is looking for a **creative, confident, and trend\-aware Content Creator** who can turn ideas, brands, products, services, and people into engaging digital content.

The candidate should be comfortable with **content research, scripting, shooting, presenting, and creating social\-media content**, especially Instagram Reels and short\-form videos.

This role is ideal for someone who understands what makes people **stop scrolling, watch, engage, and share**.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate fresh and creative content ideas for different clients and industries.
* Research trending topics, Reels formats, hooks, sounds, concepts, and social\-media trends.
* Write scripts, hooks, captions, and content concepts.
* Create content for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts and other digital platforms.
* Participate in and, when required, **appear in front of the camera** for Reels and promotional content.
* Coordinate and conduct client shoots along with the production/video team.
* Shoot basic videos using smartphones/cameras with proper framing, lighting and composition.
* Create different types of content including:
* Reels
* Talking\-head videos
* Educational videos
* Promotional videos
* Product/service videos
* Trend\-based content
* Founder/personal\-brand content
* Behind\-the\-scenes content
* Customer\-focused content
* Develop strong hooks and storytelling structures to improve viewer retention.
* Work with video editors, graphic designers, social media managers and account managers.
* Understand each client's target audience and create content accordingly.
* Maintain consistency in brand tone, messaging and visual style.
* Review published content and suggest improvements based on engagement and performance.
* Stay updated with Instagram and YouTube trends, formats and content styles.

Required Skills

* Strong creativity and idea\-generation ability.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Good command of English and Hindi/Punjabi.
* Strong understanding of Instagram Reels and short\-form content.
* Good scripting and copywriting skills.
* Understanding of hooks, storytelling and audience psychology.
* Comfortable speaking on camera.
* Basic knowledge of mobile photography/videography.
* Ability to research and understand different industries quickly.
* Good knowledge of current social\-media trends.
* Ability to work on multiple clients and meet deadlines.
* Basic knowledge of Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar tools is an advantage.

Preferred Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Confident in front of the camera**
* Naturally creative and full of content ideas
* Comfortable visiting client locations for shoots
* Active on Instagram/YouTube and aware of current trends
* Good at communicating with clients and team members
* Willing to experiment with new content formats
* Able to work in a fast\-paced digital marketing agency
* More focused on **creating content that performs** rather than simply completing assigned posts

Qualifications

A degree/diploma in **Mass Communication, Journalism, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Media, or a related field** is preferred but not mandatory.

**Freshers with a strong portfolio, personal Instagram/YouTube page, or relevant content\-creation experience can also apply.**

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with multiple brands and industries.
* Exposure to real client projects.
* Experience in social media, content strategy and digital marketing.
* Opportunity to participate in professional shoots.
* Creative and collaborative work environment.
* Growth opportunities within the organisation.

How To Apply

Interested candidates can share their **resume \+ portfolio/Instagram profile \+ examples of their previous content** with the HR team.

**Location:** The Digital Zilla, Jalandhar  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site

Pay: ₹10,148\.14 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Server
description:
**SERVER \- Larder \& Folk \| Goa**

***About Larder \& Folk***  
Larder \& Folk is a café and bakery inspired by American diner culture, personal memories and travels. Everything we serve is made with care, from our food to our breads and pastries. We believe in warm hospitality, good food, and creating an experience that feels welcoming, thoughtful and genuine.

***The Role***

We are looking for a **Server** to join the Front of House team at Larder \& Folk.

The role is centred around creating a warm, efficient and memorable experience for every guest. You will be responsible for taking orders, serving food and beverages, maintaining the dining area and working closely with the kitchen and FOH team to ensure smooth service.

The ideal candidate is friendly, attentive, confident with guests and genuinely enjoys working in a busy café environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Guest Experience***

* Welcome guests warmly and assist with seating when required.
* Be knowledgeable about the menu, ingredients, specials and bakery offerings.
* Take accurate food and beverage orders.
* Answer guest questions and make recommendations when appropriate.
* Check on tables throughout the meal and respond promptly to guest requests.
* Handle guest feedback professionally and escalate concerns to the manager when required.
* Ensure guests receive a warm, attentive and personalised experience.

***Service***

* Serve food and beverages efficiently and correctly.
* Ensure tables are properly set before service.
* Clear and reset tables promptly.
* Maintain cleanliness and organisation of the dining area throughout the shift.
* Coordinate closely with the kitchen, bar and other FOH team members.
* Follow service standards and sequence of service at all times.
* Ensure takeaway and bakery orders are packed and handed over correctly when required.

***Menu \& Product Knowledge***

* Maintain a strong understanding of the food and beverage menu.
* Be familiar with ingredients, allergens and common dietary requirements.
* Stay updated on daily specials, unavailable items and new menu additions.
* Be able to confidently explain our bakery products and house\-made offerings.

***Closing \& Opening Duties***

* Complete opening and closing checklists as assigned.
* Ensure tables, chairs, service stations and guest areas are clean and ready.
* Restock service stations and FOH supplies.
* Assist with end\-of\-day cleaning and organisation.
* Ensure all equipment and service areas are properly maintained.

***What We’re Looking For***

* Previous experience in a café, restaurant, bakery or hospitality environment is preferred.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Friendly, approachable and confident personality.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask and remain calm during busy service.
* Good grooming and personal hygiene.
* Punctual, reliable and responsible.
* Willingness to learn and take feedback.
* A genuine interest in food, hospitality and service.
* Ability to work well as part of a team.

***What Matters at Larder \& Folk***

***We value people who:***

* Take pride in their work.
* Care about the details.
* Treat guests and colleagues with respect.
* Are proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Communicate clearly with the team.
* Take ownership of mistakes and learn from them.
* Understand that good hospitality is about making people feel welcome.

*Reporting To :* Café Manager

*Location***:** Larder \& Folk, Goa

*Experience* **:** 1–3 years preferred; freshers with the right attitude may also be considered.
