title: HR Manager
description:
HR Manager — House of Daisy Location: Gurugram, Haryana \| Experience: 5–8 years \| Full\-time, on\-roll Industry: Bridal \& Celebration Wear / Fashion Retail About the role House of Daisy is a bridal and celebration wear label in Gurugram. We are looking for an HR Manager to own the complete HR function across our retail store and our in\-house production unit. This is a standalone role reporting to the Founder — you will build the function, not inherit one. Key Responsibility Areas (KRA)
   

  

* Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding Own end\-to\-end hiring for store, production, design, marketing and back\-office roles Reduce time\-to\-fill and maintain a ready talent pipeline for high\-turnover positions Ensure all positions are staffed before peak wedding and festive season Issue offer and appointment letters, complete documentation and run structured induction
* Attendance, Payroll Inputs \& Compensation Manage attendance, leave and shift rosters across both sites Deliver an accurate monthly payroll input sheet to Accounts on a fixed date Administer retail incentive schemes and production\-side wage structures Process full\-and\-final settlements and exit documentation within defined turnaround
* Statutory Compliance \& Labour Law Ensure full compliance under the new labour codes, EPF, ESI, gratuity and maternity benefit provisions Maintain establishment registrations and file all statutory returns on time Constitute and maintain the POSH Internal Committee, conduct annual awareness and file the annual return Keep the organisation audit\-ready with zero penalties or late filings
* Performance Management Run the annual KRA cycle — goal setting, mid\-year review and appraisal Ensure 100% of on\-roll employees have signed KRAs Close probation and confirmation decisions on time and on evidence Identify high performers and build a succession line for supervisory roles
* Employee Relations, Discipline \& Grievance Handling Act as first point of contact for employee grievances across both sites Handle disciplinary matters through a documented warning, show\-cause and enquiry process Resolve attendance, conduct and shift\-allocation issues fairly and on record Identify and address attrition risk before it escalates
* Training \& Development Build and execute the annual training calendar Cover client handling, product knowledge, grooming, POSH, and fire and safety Conduct shop\-floor training in Hindi for the production team Link training completion to confirmation and increment decisions
* HR Operations, Records \& Policy Maintain complete and compliant personnel files for every employee Draft and update the employee handbook and HR policies in Hindi and English Manage the HRMS / biometric attendance system and its data accuracy Publish a monthly HR dashboard — headcount, joinings, exits, attrition, open positions, cost per hire
* Employee Engagement \& Retention Drive the engagement calendar across festivals, recognition and celebrations Conduct exit interviews for all separations and report attrition trends Own the retention plan for peak season Candidate Requirements Graduate with MBA / PGDM in HR or Personnel Management 5–8 years in HR, with at least 2 years handling HR independently Experience in retail, fashion, hospitality or a retail\-plus\-production environment Working knowledge of current Indian labour legislation and hands\-on experience with PF, ESI, gratuity and POSH compliance Strong command of Hindi and English, both written and spoken Proficient in Excel and HRMS / attendance systems Based in Gurugram or willing to relocate

title: Human Resources
description:
**Company Description** 
 Rajyog International Private Limited is a well\-established leader in the marble and granite industry, founded in 1996 and recognized for its consistent growth and strong reputation. The company supplies high\-quality marble and granite blocks and slabs to global markets including China, Indonesia, Thailand, Italy, Dubai, Singapore, Oman, Turkey, Taiwan, and Vietnam. Through its subsidiary Rajyog Minerals Pvt. Ltd., the group operates multiple active mines and cutting units across India, ensuring reliable production and export of premium granite.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Human Resources Manager will oversee the full spectrum of HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, employee relations, and compliance with employment laws and company policies. The role involves developing and implementing HR policies, managing payroll and benefits administration in coordination with the finance team, and maintaining accurate employee records. The Human Resources Manager will work closely with leadership and department heads to identify workforce needs, support organizational development, and promote a positive, safe, and inclusive work environment. Daily responsibilities also include handling disciplinary procedures, conflict resolution, training coordination, and supporting employee engagement and retention initiatives. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurugram.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience in core HR functions such as recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
* Knowledge of HR policies, labor laws, compliance practices, and HR documentation relevant to operations in India.
* Skills in payroll coordination, benefits administration, and HR data management using HRIS or similar systems.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution abilities, with capacity to support employees at all levels.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; a master’s degree or HR certification is an advantage.
* Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a senior HR role, preferably in manufacturing, mining, or related industrial sectors.
* Prior experience in establishing contact with overseas companies, recruiters, or agents to support international business growth and talent sourcing.
* Proficiency with MS Office and familiarity with HR software tools; comfort working with data and HR reports.
* Commitment to ethical, gender\-neutral, and non\-discriminatory HR practices, and fostering an inclusive workplace culture.

description:
**Job Title** 
 : Senior Manager \- Field HR
 



**Department** 
 : Human Resources
 



**Location** 
 : Pune and Nagpur (2 positions)
 



**Reports To** 
 : Field HR Director
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 :
 



 We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Senior Manager \- Field HR to lead and manage the HR functions across multiple field operations. The role requires an individual with a deep understanding of HR processes, strong leadership skills, and a hands\-on approach to managing a diverse and remote workforce. The Senior Manager \- Field HR will be responsible for implementing HR strategies, ensuring employee engagement, driving talent acquisition, and managing performance across field locations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 
 :
 


* **Strategic HR Leadership** 
 :
* Partner with senior leadership to align HR initiatives with business objectives, ensuring a strong workforce in field operations.
* Provide strategic guidance on HR issues including employee relations, talent development, workforce planning, and retention.
* **Employee Relations** 
 :
* Act as a liaison between management and employees in the field, ensuring effective communication and resolving employee concerns.
* Handle complex employee relations issues, disciplinary actions, and grievance processes.
* Promote a positive organizational culture and foster employee engagement.
* **Talent Acquisition \& Management** 
 :
* Oversee the recruitment and onboarding processes for field employees, ensuring timely hiring and smooth integration.
* Work with recruitment teams to build talent pipelines and strengthen employer branding in field locations.
* Implement training and development programs that cater to the needs of field employees.
* **Performance Management** 
 :
* Support the implementation of performance management processes, ensuring consistent application of evaluation methods and timely feedback.
* Monitor key HR metrics and work with managers to identify and address performance gaps.
* Lead performance improvement initiatives and talent succession planning.
* **HR Compliance and Policy Implementation** 
 :
* Ensure that field operations comply with labor laws, company policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure the consistency and fairness of HR practices across the field workforce.
* **Reporting and Analytics** 
 :
* Provide regular reports and insights on HR performance in field operations, including turnover rates, employee satisfaction, and training effectiveness.
* Monitor the effectiveness of HR initiatives and make data\-driven recommendations for improvement.
* **Team Leadership \& Development** 
 :
* Lead, coach, and mentor HR field teams to ensure they are aligned with the organization's goals and objectives.
* Manage the professional development of HR team members and help them grow in their roles.

 :
* Lead change management efforts in the field, ensuring smooth transitions and the effective implementation of new HR initiatives or policies.
* Support leadership in driving transformation projects and aligning the workforce with evolving business needs.

 :
 


* **Education** 
 :
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s degree or HR certification preferred).

* Strong knowledge of labor laws and HR best practices.
* **Skills**

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with diverse teams.
* Excellent problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Proficient in HRIS systems, Microsoft Office, and data analytics tools.



  





**Key Competencies** 
 :
 


* Leadership and team management
* Strategic thinking and business acumen
* Conflict management and employee relations expertise
* High emotional intelligence
* Strong analytical and reporting skills

**Preferred**

* Experience in multi\-location or field operations.

title: Human Capital Associate
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Human Capital Associate to join our team. In this role, you will support key HR functions across talent acquisition, HR operations, onboarding, employee engagement, and employee support. You will work closely with hiring managers and employees to ensure a seamless people experience while contributing to the growth of the organization.
   

  

 If you enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment, thrive on ownership, and are passionate about building great employee and candidate experiences, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities: \-**
**Talent Acquisition**
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for internship and full\-time roles across different functions.
* Source candidates through job portals, referrals, and other hiring channels.
* Screen applications, coordinate interviews, and ensure a smooth hiring process.
* Deliver a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Maintain recruitment data and hiring trackers.


**Employee Onboarding**
* Coordinate the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new hires.
* Ensure all pre\-joining and joining formalities are completed accurately and on time.
* Deliver a seamless onboarding experience while familiarizing new employees with company policies, processes, and culture.


**Human Resources Operations**
* Maintain accurate employee records, documentation, employment agreements, and human resources databases.
* Manage attendance, leave records, and employee data through the Human Resources Management System.
* Assist with payroll inputs and ensure smooth day\-to\-day human resources operations.


**Employee Engagement and Events**
* Support the planning and execution of employee engagement initiatives and company events.
* Coordinate logistics for both virtual and in\-office activities.
* Contribute ideas and initiatives that strengthen employee engagement and company culture.


**Employee Support and Query resolution**
* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries related to policies, attendance, leave, documentation, and human resources processes.
* Ensure timely resolution of employee concerns while maintaining confidentiality.
* Provide guidance and support throughout the employee lifecycle.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field.
* 1 to 2 years of experience in Human Resources, preferably in a startup or fast\-paced environment.
* Hands\-on experience in talent acquisition and human resources operations.
* Familiarity with any HRMS.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.


**What You Will Gain**
* Exposure to the complete employee lifecycle in a high\-growth company.
* Opportunity to work closely with leadership and hiring managers.
* Ownership of key human resources initiatives and projects.
* A collaborative environment that encourages learning, innovation, and continuous growth.


**How We Work**

title: Head HR
description:
We are looking for a
 **Head of Human Resources** 
 with 20\+ years of comprehensive HR leadership experience spanning corporate strategy and plant\-level execution. This role requires a business\-savvy leader who can seamlessly switch between strategic boardroom discussions (compensation restructuring, talent pipelines, M\&A/org design) and ground\-level plant HR operations (EHS, plant productivity, labor compliance, shop\-floor engagement).
 



 Core Key Result Areas (KRAs) \& Responsibilities
 



  





 1\.
 **Corporate HR \& Strategic Talent Management** 




  




* **Strategic HR Partnering:** 
 Translate long\-term business goals into human capital strategies, org structure design, and manpower budgets.
* **Leadership Acquisition:** 
 Drive executive search and top\-tier hiring for leadership, specialized engineering, R\&D, and business heads.
* **Total Rewards \& Comp\-Benefits:** 
 Design competitive compensation structures, variable pay schemes, long\-term incentive plans (LTIPs), and benefit benchmarkings across corporate and operational bands.
* **Performance Management (PMS):** 
 Drive OKR/KPI frameworks, annual appraisal cycles, calibration matrices, and performance improvement plans (PIP).
* **Talent Management \& Succession Planning:** 
 Identify high\-potential talent (HIPO), build leadership pipelines, and establish succession plans for critical C\-suite and plant leadership roles.



  





 2\.
 **Plant HR \& Manufacturing Operations** 




  




* **Plant HR Governance:** 
 Oversee site\-level HR heads across facilities to ensure smooth daily shop\-floor operations, shift planning, and absenteeism management.
* **Industrial Relations \& Compliance:** 
 Manage labor dynamics, trade unions, long\-term wage settlements (LTWS), and zero\-stoppage operations while maintaining 100% adherence to labor laws and Factory Acts.
* **Contract Labor Management:** 
 Optimize contract workforce deployment, vendor compliance, productivity norms, and statutory obligations (PF, ESI, Factory Rules).
* **EHS \& Employee Welfare:** 
 Enforce safety culture, health protocols, plant canteen/transport infrastructure, and environmental safety standards (ISO/OHSAS).



  





 3\.
 **HR Operations, Systems \& Governance** 




  




* **HR Digitalization \& Tech:** 
 Implement and optimize HRMS, ATS, payroll engines, and attendance/time\-tracking systems across corporate and site locations.
* **HR Analytics \& Metrics:** 
 Track critical metrics—Attrition Rate, Cost\-per\-Hire, Revenue\-per\-Employee, Overtime Cost, and Employee Engagement Scores.
* **Policy \& Governance:** 
 Formulate, review, and roll out corporate policies, code of conduct, POSH guidelines, and disciplinary protocols.



  





 4\.
 **Organization Development (OD) \& Learning** 




  




* **Capability Building:** 
 Build functional/technical training matrices for plant workers and leadership/soft\-skills programs for corporate teams.
* **Culture \& Engagement:** 
 Drive company\-wide core values, employee pulse surveys, reward \& recognition (R\&R) programs, and DEI initiatives.



  





**Required Profile \& Competencies** 




  




* **Education:** 
 Full\-time MBA / MSW
* **Experience:** 
 20\+ years of total HR experience, with at least 8\-10 years in a Head of HR / CHRO capacity managing dual corporate and multi\-plant environments.
* **Industry Focus:** 
 Automotive, Heavy Engineering, Process Manufacturing, Logistics, or FMCG.



  





**Key Behavioral Traits** 



* High business acumen \& strategic perspective.
* Strong negotiation and crisis management capabilities.
* Ability to connect with shop\-floor workers as effectively as C\-suite executives.

title: Senior Executive - HR Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




*1\. Onboarding \& Induction* 



* Coordinate pre\-joining formalities: offer/appointment letter issuance, document collection and joining schedules.
* Conduct joining formalities and the induction programme covering company overview, policies, safety norms, code of conduct and systems access.
* Coordinate with IT, Admin, Accounts and department heads for laptops, ID cards, email IDs, access and seating before Day 1\.
* Track probation and confirmation timelines, and collect new\-joiner feedback at 30/60/90 days.
* Maintain the joiner checklist and ensure complete, verified personnel files (including BGV coordination with the HR Manager).



*2\. Attendance \& Leave Management* 



* Consolidate and validate daily/monthly attendance from biometric or HRMS systems.
* Track leaves, late marks, on\-duty entries and regularisations, and resolve discrepancies with department heads.
* Share the finalised attendance and leave data with the payroll team by the cut\-off date.



*3\. Payroll Support* 



* Prepare monthly payroll inputs: joiners, exits, attendance, leave encashment, incentives, reimbursements and deductions.
* Check payroll sheets/reports for accuracy before release and raise variances with the HR Manager.
* Support statutory compliance inputs (PF, ESI, PT, TDS) and coordinate with Accounts/Finance and auditors as required.
* Handle employee payroll queries and payslip\-related requests.



*4\. TA/DA Processing* 



* Receive, verify and process employee travel claims (TA) and daily allowance (DA) against company policy and approvals.
* Check supporting documents, rate eligibility and grade entitlements, and flag policy deviations.
* Coordinate claim settlement with Accounts and maintain the monthly TA/DA tracker and reports.



*5\. General HR Operations* 



* Maintain the employee master data, HRIS records and HR MIS (headcount, attrition, joiners/exits, attendance summaries).
* Support the exit process: resignation acceptance, clearance, full \& final inputs and issue of relieving/experience letters.
* Issue HR letters and certificates (confirmation, salary/employment verification, transfers, etc.).
* Assist with employee engagement activities, statutory displays/registers and audits.
* Support the HR Manager on policy updates, performance appraisal cycles and ad\-hoc HR projects.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* MBA/PGDM in HR or a graduate degree with a specialisation in HR.
* 4–7 years of experience in HR operations, preferably in a manufacturing, steel, power or other industrial setup.
* Hands\-on experience in onboarding, attendance management, payroll processing and reimbursement/TA\-DA handling.



**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Working knowledge of payroll and labour compliance (PF, ESI, PT, Factories Act basics, Payment of Wages, etc.).
* Proficient in MS Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables) and any HRMS/payroll software.
* Strong attention to detail, confidentiality and deadline discipline.
* Good communication and coordination skills across levels, from plant floor to senior management.
* Ability to conduct engaging induction sessions and handle multiple tasks at once.



**Key Performance Indicators** 



* Onboarding completion and document accuracy (zero Day\-1 gaps)
* Attendance and payroll input turnaround, with error rate
* TA/DA claim turnaround time and policy adherence
* New\-joiner feedback and probation\-completion tracking
* Timeliness and accuracy of HR MIS reports

title: Network Infrastructure Specialist
description:
Design and implement robust network cabling and enterprise\-grade switching environments.
  
Service overview


Scope, process, and practical detail for Hyderabad teams.


At 365 Admin Support and Services, we believe that the backbone of every successful business in Hyderabad is a robust, well\-managed IT infrastructure. Our mission is to provide seamless technology solutions to small and medium enterprises (SMEs), and that mission begins with our people. We are constantly seeking dedicated professionals who are passionate about technology, problem\-solving, and delivering exceptional service to the local business community.


Joining our team means becoming part of a practical, results\-oriented environment. We don’t focus on vanity metrics or corporate jargon; we focus on keeping our clients’ businesses running smoothly. As a key player in **IT Support Hyderabad**, we offer a workplace where technical skill is matched by a commitment to reliability and integrity.


**The Scope of Our Work**
-------------------------


Working at 365 Admin Support and Services involves more than just troubleshooting software. Our team manages the complete lifecycle of business technology. From initial hardware procurement and network design to ongoing maintenance and cybersecurity, our staff gains exposure to every facet of modern IT operations.


One of our core service pillars is providing comprehensive **Computer AMC Hyderabad** (Annual Maintenance Contracts). For our team members, this means managing diverse environments, performing proactive system health checks, and ensuring that our clients’ hardware—from servers to individual workstations—operates at peak efficiency. You will work with a variety of hardware brands and software ecosystems, ensuring no two days are exactly the same.


**Our Recruitment and Growth Process**
--------------------------------------


We take a methodical approach to building our team. We look for candidates who possess not only the technical certifications but also the "soft skills" required to explain complex technical issues to business owners in a way that makes sense. Our process is transparent and straightforward:


* **Technical Assessment:** We evaluate your hands\-on knowledge of networking, server management, and desktop support.
* **Practical Troubleshooting:** Candidates are often given real\-world scenarios to solve, reflecting the daily challenges our clients face.
* **Cultural Fit:** We value punctuality, honesty, and a service\-first mindset. We look for team players who understand that our clients' uptime is our primary priority.
* **Continuous Training:** The IT landscape changes rapidly. We encourage our staff to stay updated with the latest in cloud computing, cybersecurity, and remote management tools.

**Honest SLAs and Service Standards**
-------------------------------------


In the world of **Hyderabad business IT**, trust is built on honesty. We do not make unrealistic promises of "instant" fixes for every problem. Instead, we operate on clear, honest Service Level Agreements (SLAs) that prioritize critical issues and provide realistic timelines for resolution.


Our employees are trained to manage these expectations professionally. When you work with us, you are empowered by clear protocols that define response times and escalation paths. This structure ensures that our team is never overwhelmed and our clients are never left in the dark.


**Industries We Serve**
-----------------------

title: Cloud Operations Data Analyst
description:
Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future\-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible. The Stantec community unites approximately 32,000 employees working in over 450 locations across 6 continents.
   

  

 At Stantec, we're driven by a shared purpose to bring people, technology, and data together to create impact across our clients and communities. Our Digital Centre of Excellence (CoE) supports this mission by improving internal efficiency, enabling scalable innovation, and strengthening collaboration through modern digital and cloud technologies.
   

  

 We are seeking an Operations Data Analyst to work in the Digital Solutions Architecture and Operations team to support the effective operation, optimization, and financial management of cloud\-based services. Working closely with our Asset and Products team and the wider operations, technical, and business stakeholders, this role will turn operational data into clear evidence that helps teams understand cost, performance, reliability, and the root causes of service issues. The ideal candidate combines analytical discipline with an appreciation of cloud operations and a practical familiarity with Microsoft Azure technologies.
   

  

 Your Opportunity
   

  

 The Operations Data Analyst will play a key role in helping Stantec proactively make informed, evidence\-based decisions in the operation of our Azure Landing Zone environments. The role will gather, validate, analyse, and present operational and financial data from Azure and related platforms, supporting our FinOps activities, service improvement, incident analysis, and cost accountability.
   

  

 Working within a Microsoft\-based environment, you will use query, data transformation, and visualisation tools to investigate patterns, test hypotheses, identify contributing factors, and communicate findings in a way that is meaningful to both technical and non\-technical audiences. While helping establish repeatable analysis methods, trusted reporting, and actionable insights that improve operational outcomes, this is not just management reporting. This role is about making a positive difference in how we run our cloud operations, especially when troubleshooting operational issues with the technical teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \- Operational Data Analysis \& FinOps
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Have The Following Responsibilities**
* Collect, check, and organize operational, usage, performance, and cost data from Microsoft Azure and related platforms.
* Support FinOps and operational reporting across DCoE and with Digital Practices by identifying cost drivers, usage trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Use KQL, Power Query, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and other Microsoft tools to analyze data and create clear reports, with support and training where needed.
* Assist technical teams with investigations into incidents, service issues, unexpected costs, and recurring operational problems.
* Present findings in a simple, evidence\-based way, clearly highlighting known facts, assumptions, data quality issues, and recommended next steps.
* Work with cloud, finance, service management, and engineering colleagues to improve data quality, tagging, reporting consistency, and operational insight.


 Your Capabilities and Credentials
   

  

* Apply structured analytical thinking and practical problem\-solving to operational questions, with guidance where needed.
* Demonstrate an appreciation of cloud operations, including reliability, monitoring, resource utilization, support processes, and cost management.
* Use or develop skills in KQL, Power Query, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and related tools to analyze data and present clear findings.
* Communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including assumptions, evidence limits, and recommended next steps.
* Collaborate constructively across operations, finance, engineering, architecture, and service management teams while continuing to build Azure and operational knowledge.


**Education, Qualifications \& Experience**
* Relevant experience or interests in data analysis, operational analysis, cloud operations, service management, business intelligence, FinOps, or related discipline.
* Practical familiarity with Microsoft Azure concepts, cost and usage data, monitoring, logging, and reporting tools; deeper platform knowledge can be developed in the role.
* Experience using analytical tools such as Excel, Power Query, Power BI, or Microsoft Fabric with awareness of SQL, KQL, to investigate data, identify trends, and present clear findings.


 Desirable
   

  

* Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Cost Management, Resource Graph, Workbooks, or related Azure operational tools.
* Awareness of cloud cost models, tagging, budgets, licensing, cost allocation, and basic FinOps principles.
* Exposure to service management processes, data governance, security, privacy, or role\-based access considerations in cloud environments.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, governed dashboards, enterprise reporting, distributed organizations, or the architecture, engineering, and construction industry would be beneficial.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 The Unified Configuration Management team within Cloud \& Production Engineering is mission\-critical to Docusign's reliability and deployment speed. We architect and maintain internal platforms for progressive delivery, providing the infrastructure for feature flagging, experimentation, and configuration management. Our scope extends to Change Insights, where we develop advanced correlation models to pinpoint incident root causes within minutes. We empower engineering teams to release features with velocity and confidence while ensuring our customers benefit from granular feature control and system stability.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Engineering Manager, Unified Configuration Management.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Design, author, and audit technical designs for features and components. Own the end\-to\-end delivery of well\-defined features by executing assignments independently with moderate guidance
* Develop and maintain high\-quality, scalable back\-end services. This includes building and scaling the robust services, component libraries, and maintaining Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines for safe deployments across Azure and GCP
* Author and own comprehensive testing plans, writing high\-quality, reliable tests (unit, component, E2E). Drive quality by demonstrating competence in debugging across multiple components, environments, and external dependencies to ensure features are testable, observable, and safe to roll out
* Implement and refine telemetry (metrics, logs, traces), dashboards, and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Participate in on\-call rotations, perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for issues, and use data to drive operational improvements and strengthen runbooks
* Work within the Agile framework, proactively identifying dependencies and critical paths, proposing mitigation plans, and collaborating with cross\-functional partners to resolve blockers. Drive continuous improvement by developing efficiencies to scale processes and staying current with emerging technologies


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Basic**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years of professional experience building back\-end, platform, or reliability\-focused services
* Experience with at least one modern programming language (C\#, Java, or Go)
* Experience with distributed systems, data structures, and production reliability fundamentals
* Experience with web services, APIs (REST/gRPC), and working with JSON/structured data
* Experience with Git, complex CI/CD workflows, automated testing frameworks, and Agile practices
* Experience leveraging coding assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for problem solving, debugging, profiling, and documentation


**Preferred**
* Experience building and operating back\-end services in Azure or GCP, with hands\-on experience using Terraform and Infrastructure\-as\-Code
* Expertise in progressive delivery, configuration management, or feature\-flagging systems (e.g., Optimizely)
* Experience with observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) to debug system health and correlate incidents
* Strong incident response background: experience with on\-call rotations, root\-cause analysis (RCA), and operational readiness reviews
* Demonstrated ability to own features end\-to\-end, including design trade\-offs, rollout strategies, and post\-launch support


 Life at Docusign
   

  

**Working here**
 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
   

  

 We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

title: Electronics Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Junior Electronics Engineer, **Fresher OR with 1\-2 years of professional experience** in electronics design and PCB development to join our engineering team in Kolkata. This is a full\-time, on\-site role, ideal for candidates looking to expand their skills in circuit design, PCB layout, component selection, and embedded hardware bring\-up.

As a Junior Electronics Engineer, you will work on a range of technologies including analog and digital circuits, microcontroller\-based systems, IoT applications, and medical device electronics, while designing reliable and optimized hardware solutions for real\-world applications. You will collaborate with senior engineers, firmware teams, and cross\-functional groups to deliver production\-ready electronic systems.

Recent graduates with demonstrated hands\-on exposure to circuit design and KiCad PCB tools through academic projects, internships, or personal projects are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Circuit Design \& Development

* Design complete or partial electronic circuits based on technical specifications, system requirements, and application constraints
* Perform detailed circuit analysis and simulations using industry\-standard tools (SPICE, LTspice, or equivalent)
* Create comprehensive schematic diagrams with proper component annotation, reference designators, and detailed documentation
* Conduct design calculations for analog circuits, signal conditioning, power distribution, and signal integrity
* Ensure all designs meet performance specifications, reliability standards, and safety requirements
* Implement best practices for noise reduction, EMI/EMC compliance, and thermal management
* Participate actively in design reviews with senior engineers and stakeholders, incorporating feedback and design improvements
* Evaluate alternative circuit topologies and component solutions to optimize performance, cost, and manufacturability

Component Selection \& Sourcing

* Evaluate and analyze comprehensive component datasheets and technical specifications
* Select appropriate semiconductors (microcontrollers, op\-amps, voltage regulators, analog\-to\-digital converters, etc.), passive components (resistors, capacitors, inductors, transformers), and functional modules based on circuit requirements
* Consider critical factors including performance parameters, power consumption, operating temperature ranges, availability, lead times, cost\-effectiveness, and supply chain reliability
* Maintain and continuously update component libraries and design documentation for future project reuse
* Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure component availability, manage obsolescence risks, and optimize cost without compromising quality
* Document component selections with justifications and alternative options for design flexibility

PCB Layout \& Routing

* Utilize **KiCad or EasyEDA** (schematic capture and PCB design tools) to translate detailed schematics into production\-ready PCB layouts
* Design single, double, and multi\-layer PCBs with proper layer stackup optimization for signal integrity and manufacturability
* Perform comprehensive PCB Design Rule Checks (DRC) and ensure full compliance with manufacturing specifications and design guidelines
* Execute critical signal integrity analysis including impedance matching, crosstalk assessment, and timing analysis for high\-speed signals
* Design optimal power distribution networks (PDN) and ground planes to minimize voltage drops and noise
* Route complex signal paths while adhering to design constraints including trace width, spacing, and via placement rules
* Implement thermal management strategies through copper pours, thermal vias, and optimized component placement
* Optimize PCB layouts for cost efficiency, manufacturability, and assembly considerations
* Generate complete manufacturing documentation including layer stackups, silkscreen markings, assembly drawings, design specifications, and manufacturing notes
* Conduct design for manufacturability (DFM) reviews with manufacturing partners
* Work with fabrication houses to ensure designs meet production capabilities and tolerances

Firmware Development for Testing \& Board Bring\-Up

* Develop and maintain embedded firmware for microcontroller\-based designs primarily in C/C\+\+
* Create validation and testing firmware that comprehensively exercises hardware functionality
* Implement drivers and application logic for microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, ARM Cortex\-M, RISC\-V, Arduino, or equivalent platforms)
* Support standard communication protocols including I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, and GPIO
* Perform comprehensive board bring\-up activities including power\-on sequencing, clock verification, and peripheral initialization
* Execute functional testing and validation of all hardware subsystems and components
* Debug hardware issues and design flaws using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and software debugging tools
* Maintain detailed test procedures, logs, and documentation for quality assurance and future reference
* Collaborate with firmware engineers to ensure hardware\-software integration and performance optimization

Documentation \& Knowledge Management

* Maintain comprehensive and well\-organized design documentation including schematics, PCB layouts, bill of materials (BOM), design specifications, and change logs
* Prepare detailed technical reports, design summaries, and project documentation for internal reviews and client deliverables
* Create and maintain design standards and best practice guidelines for team consistency and knowledge sharing
* Document design decisions, trade\-offs, and lessons learned for organizational knowledge base
* Prepare presentations and technical summaries for design reviews and stakeholder communications

Collaboration \& Cross\-Functional Teamwork

* Work closely with senior hardware engineers and technical leads to understand requirements, constraints, and design objectives
* Partner with firmware engineers for seamless hardware\-software integration and optimal system performance
* Collaborate with mechanical engineers on component placement, thermal considerations, and mechanical constraints
* Coordinate with quality assurance and testing teams to address design issues and implement improvements
* Communicate technical findings, design decisions, and challenges clearly with internal teams and external clients
* Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives

Required QualificationsExperience \& Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)
* 1\+ year of demonstrated experience in electronics design, circuit development, or PCB layout in professional or academic settings
* OR recent graduate with proven hands\-on exposure to circuit design and PCB development through academic projects, internships, or personal projects
* Portfolio, GitHub repository, or work samples demonstrating circuit design and PCB layout capabilities (highly valued)

Technical Skills \- Essential

* Proficiency in KiCad including schematic capture, PCB layout, and design rule checking
* Strong foundational knowledge of analog and digital circuit design principles
* Comprehensive understanding of passive components (resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, relays) and active components (op\-amps, transistors, voltage regulators, comparators)
* Knowledge of microcontroller basics and embedded systems architecture (ARM, AVR, RISC\-V)
* Proficiency in C/C\+\+ programming for embedded systems and microcontroller development
* Solid grasp of PCB design fundamentals including layer stackup, trace routing, via placement, and manufacturing constraints
* Understanding of signal integrity concepts including impedance, crosstalk, and propagation delay
* Familiarity with power distribution and basic power supply design concepts

Technical Skills \- Practical Experience

* Hands\-on experience with component selection from datasheets and specification evaluation
* Practical knowledge of communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, or GPIO
* Familiarity with basic circuit simulation concepts (SPICE, LTspice, or similar tools)
* Experience with debugging and testing tools including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and multimeters
* Proficiency with schematic capture and PCB design software (KiCad preferred; experience with Altium, Eagle, or equivalent is acceptable)

Soft Skills \& Attributes

* Exceptional attention to detail with commitment to design quality and accuracy
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with systematic troubleshooting approach
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and team collaboration
* Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills
* Self\-motivated and proactive with genuine enthusiasm for continuous learning and professional development
* Willing to ask questions and seek guidance from senior engineers

Preferred Qualifications (Good to have, but not necessary)Advanced Technical Skills

* Familiarity with circuit simulation tools including LTspice, Proteus, or PSPICE
* Experience with power electronics design including switching regulators, DC\-DC converters, or power management ICs
* Knowledge of high\-speed PCB design including impedance matching and differential pair routing
* Exposure to signal processing concepts and analog filter design
* Familiarity with RTOS concepts (FreeRTOS, Zephyr) for embedded firmware development

Industry\-Specific Experience

* Experience with medical device design including understanding of regulatory requirements and design controls
* Knowledge of India MDR, CDSCO regulations, and compliance requirements for medical devices
* Exposure to IEC, FCC, CE, and other electrical safety standards
* Experience with healthcare applications or medical\-grade electronics
* Background in IoT device design or wireless embedded systems
* Familiarity with wearable electronics or sensor\-based system design

Professional Development \& Tools

* Experience with version control systems (Git, GitHub, GitLab) for design collaboration
* Proficiency in Python or Shell scripting for test automation and firmware development
* Familiarity with hardware description languages (Verilog, VHDL) for FPGA design (a plus)
* Knowledge of PCB assembly processes including surface mount technology (SMT) and component placement optimization
* Experience with thermal analysis and simulation tools
* Hands\-on experience with hardware testing methodologies and quality assurance processes
* Familiarity with design documentation standards and ISO specifications

Industry Credentials

* Professional certifications in electronics engineering or embedded systems (valuable but not required)
* Completed online courses in PCB design, embedded systems, or circuit design from recognized institutions

What We OfferCareer Development \& Learning

* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge embedded systems, IoT products, and medical device electronics
* Direct mentorship and guidance from experienced senior hardware engineers and technical leads
* Comprehensive exposure to the complete product development lifecycle from concept to manufacturing
* Access to advanced design tools and laboratory equipment including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and test equipment
* Regular technical training and skill development opportunities
* Involvement in challenging projects with real\-world applications that impact users

Work Environment \& Culture

* Collaborative and supportive team environment with emphasis on knowledge sharing
* Opportunity to contribute ideas and participate in design innovation initiatives
* Clear communication with transparent project goals and expectations
* Recognition and appreciation for technical contributions and achievements
* Inclusive and respectful workplace culture
* Flexibility for continuous learning and professional growth

Compensation \& Benefits

* Competitive salary and benefits package commensurate with experience
* Performance\-based incentives and bonuses
* Career growth opportunities with clear progression toward senior engineering and leadership roles
* Potential for specialized role development (medical devices, IoT, power electronics, etc.)

Location and Work Mode

* Employment Type: Full\-time
* Work Mode: Work from office / On\-site
* Primary Location: Sodepur, Kolkata, India
* Work Hours: Standard business hours with flexibility for critical project milestones

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit the following materials:

1\. **Resume/CV** \- Highlighting relevant experience, projects, internships, and technical achievements

2\. **Cover Letter** \- Explaining your interest in the role, career objectives, and why you are suited for this position

3\. **Portfolio or Project Samples** \- Links to design files, GitHub repositories, or documentation of past projects (Fritzing designs, KiCad projects, technical reports)

4\. **References** \- Names and contact information of previous supervisors, mentors, or colleagues who can speak to your technical abilities

5\. **Certifications** (if applicable) \- Any relevant technical certifications or training completion documents

About Our Company

We are a specialized electronics design company based in Kolkata focused on contract electronics design, PCB development, and embedded product manufacturing. Our expertise spans medical devices, IoT applications, consumer electronics, and industrial embedded systems. We work with diverse clients to transform concepts into production\-ready hardware solutions.

We maintain a culture of technical excellence, continuous innovation, and collaborative problem\-solving. Our team is committed to delivering high\-quality, reliable products that meet stringent industry standards and client expectations.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable team and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background, experience level, or personal characteristics. We encourage applications from underrepresented groups in engineering and provide a supportive environment for professional growth and development.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Sodepur, Kolkata, West Bengal: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Location:

* Sodepur, Kolkata, West Bengal (Preferred)

* Identify log and event sources including Active Directory event logs, Routers, Switches, Firewalls, PCAP/Flow data, DNS, audit and authentication logs, VPN, IDS, and other sensor field tools and technologies

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or other related disciplines.

 Professional Security certifications are a plus

* Vulnerability Management

* Strong time management and multitasking abilities
* Information security mindset
* Team leadership capabilities
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Outstanding communication and documentation abilities
* Autonomous and self\-organized
* Experience in tactical coordination during incidents

This is where our true strength lies. In you. In your future colleagues and in all your differences. And of course, in your ideas to improve lives while preserving our planet’s beauty for the generations to come.
   

 Join us at Syensqo, where our IT team is gearing up to enhance its capabilities. We play a crucial role in the group's transformation—accelerating growth, reshaping progress, and creating sustainable shared value.  Here at Syensqo, we're one strong team! Our commitment to accountability drives us as we work hard to deliver value for our customers and stakeholders. In our dynamic and collaborative work environment, we add a touch of enjoyment while staying true to our motto: reinvent progress.
   

 Come be part of our transformation journey and contribute to the change as a future team member.
   

 We are looking for:
   

 As a Syensqo SecOps Engineer you will be on the frontline of our cyber defence, responsible for monitoring, detecting, analysing, and responding to security incidents. You will play a vital part in maintaining the security posture of our systems, networks, and data, ensuring we are resilient against evolving cyber threats. This role offers the chance to work with advanced security technologies and contribute to building a robust security operations function.
   

 Key responsibilities
   

 Cloud security management
   

* Implement and manage security controls and best practices for cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements


 Security Monitoring and Alerting
   

* Monitor security alerts and incidents across multi\-cloud environments
* Respond to security incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions


 Vulnerability Management
   

* Support regular vulnerability scanning activities.
* Assist in the analysis and prioritisation of identified vulnerabilities
* Collaborate with development and operations teams to remediate identified vulnerabilities


 Security Tooling and Automation
   

* Assist in the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of security tools and technologies
* Develop and implement automation scripts (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to streamline security operations tasks, improve efficiency, and enhance response capabilities
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of our security operations processes and playbooks


 Documentation and Reporting
   

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date documentation for security operations procedures, incident response plans, and system configurations.
* Generate regular reports on security incidents, alerts, and the overall security posture for management and stakeholders

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related field
* Proven experience in security operations, preferably in a multi\-cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure)
* Strong knowledge of cloud security frameworks and tools
* Experience with security monitoring, incident response and vulnerability management


 Language skills
   

* Fluent English

* Help make a difference and thrive in Cloud and AI technology
* Chart your own course and build a fantastic career

Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M\+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.
   

  

**Why join Coupa?**
* Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend
* Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence
* Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.


 Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.
   

  

**The Impact of Security Engineering to Coupa:**
 Coupa's Security Engineer is a key part of the Red Team, responsible for challenging and improving the company's security posture by simulating real\-world attacks. This role will involve executing programs and tools to protect the Coupa Cloud for our growing customer base. This is a hands\-on role. We need people who are self\-motivated, have a strong desire to learn, a can\-do attitude, tenacity to solve problems, team players, and results focused.

* Develop, deploy, and manage AI agents for continuous and autonomous security testing and vulnerability discovery
* Identify network and system vulnerabilities and provide recommended countermeasures or mitigating controls to reduce risk to an acceptable and manageable level
* Perform penetration and remediation testing \& reporting and apply advanced penetration techniques in a fast\-paced, highly technical environment

title: Penetration Testing
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Penetration Testing professional based in India.**
 This remote role offers the opportunity to conduct hands\-on security assessments across web applications, APIs, networks, and cloud environments.
   

  

 You will independently execute penetration testing engagements, identify vulnerabilities, and demonstrate their real\-world impact through practical proof\-of\-concepts.
   

  

 The position combines automated security tooling with manual testing techniques to uncover complex and meaningful security weaknesses.
   

  

 You will translate technical findings into clear, actionable remediation guidance and polished client\-ready reports.
   

  

 The role also includes direct interaction with clients through scoping discussions, kickoff meetings, and report reviews.
   

  

 Beyond individual engagements, you will contribute to quality assurance, peer reviews, internal research, tooling, and improvements to testing methodologies.
   

  

 It is well suited to a security professional who combines strong offensive security skills with clear communication, independence, and a collaborative mindset.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Execute penetration testing engagements across web applications, APIs, networks, and cloud environments with minimal supervision.
* Assess applications and infrastructure using a combination of automated tools and manual testing techniques.
* Identify, validate, exploit, and document security vulnerabilities with clear evidence and practical proof\-of\-concepts.
* Evaluate vulnerabilities across areas such as authentication, authorization, injection, XSS, SQL injection, XXE, SSRF, deserialization, file inclusion, path traversal, and remote code execution.
* Develop practical, risk\-based remediation recommendations that help clients address identified security weaknesses.
* Configure and operate penetration testing tools and develop supporting scripts or tooling where appropriate.
* Produce accurate, high\-quality, client\-ready penetration testing reports with clear technical findings and business\-relevant context.
* Participate in client\-facing activities, including scoping discussions, project kickoff calls, technical discussions, and report reviews.
* Perform quality assurance reviews and peer reviews of security assessment deliverables.
* Contribute to internal security research, tooling, testing methodologies, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with other security professionals to maintain consistent delivery quality and share technical knowledge.
* Handle sensitive client information responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and professionalism throughout engagements.


**Requirements**
* 2–5 years of professional experience in penetration testing, offensive security, or a closely related cybersecurity discipline.
* Industry\-recognized offensive security certification or equivalent practical experience; certifications from organizations such as SANS, Offensive Security, or eLearnSecurity are valued.
* Strong practical experience testing web applications and APIs, including REST, SOAP, XML, and JSON\-based services.
* Experience with thick\-client applications and familiarity with modern web technologies and frameworks such as Angular and Bootstrap.
* Strong understanding of computer networks, web and mobile applications, common security vulnerabilities, and established security frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10\.
* Knowledge of common CVEs and the ability to assess and exploit vulnerabilities in realistic environments.
* Experience with vulnerabilities including XSS, SQL injection, XXE, SSRF, insecure deserialization, file inclusion/path traversal, authentication flaws, and remote code execution.
* Ability to develop proof\-of\-concepts that clearly demonstrate the potential impact and exploitability of identified vulnerabilities.

title: System Security Software Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is seeking a highly motivated, creative system software engineer with strong embedded, kernel/driver, and security experience to join the GPU Software team in Pune, Maharashtra. As someone who is hardworking and passionate about their work, you will design and build key security features and verification strategies for NVIDIA GPUs. You should demonstrate the ability to excel in an environment with complex, multifaceted software and hardware designs.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Define, design, develop and verify security and platform features for next\-gen RISCV and other in\-house controllers on NVIDIA GPUs, collaborating closely with hardware, firmware and system software teams.
* Perform security analysis and hardening of various firmware \& middleware (threat modeling, code reviews, static/dynamic analysis, fuzzing, negative testing).
* Follow the devices from inception through silicon bring‑up and production into desktops, notebooks, workstations, data centers, and gaming console products that are used throughout the world.
* Use pre‑silicon modeling, simulation and emulation to validate system and security properties early, de‑risk bring‑up, and shift‑left defect discovery.
* Multiple opportunities to collaborate and communicate effectively with distributed teams across time zones.
* Use AI‑assisted tools to improve development, review, and testing efficiency while staying aligned with NVIDIA security and coding best practices.


**What We Need To See**
* B.Tech./B.E. degree or higher (Computer science or related) or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ yrs of relevant software development experience, especially with embedded systems and/or kernel/driver stack.
* Strong interest and background in software and hardware security, with hands‑on experience building or maintaining security‑relevant features.
* Excellent C programming skills and experience with low‑level, resource‑constrained or real‑time environments (bare‑metal or RTOS) and device driver or BSP development.
* Solid understanding of computer architecture and SoC fundamentals (caches, buses, MMUs, memory controllers, DMA, interrupt controllers, security islands, fuses).
* Experience with complex system‑level debugging (cross‑component issues involving firmware, drivers, and hardware).
* Comfortable using AI tools for development, code reviews, and testing in a secure and responsible way.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive designs and reviews across teams.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience with RISC‑V architecture, low‑level BSP / firmware bring‑up, toolchains, and/or on‑chip security controllers.
* Strong understanding of hardware security, applied cryptography, and secure coding practices, especially for embedded controllers and firmware.
* Hands\-on work with secure boot, code integrity and confidentiality, TEEs, keys provisioning/rotation.
* Experience with simulation/emulation and silicon bring‑up for security or control processors (FPGA prototyping, virtual platforms, QEMU/PQEMU, emulators).
* Familiarity with security verification techniques: fuzzing, fault‑injection, coverage‑driven security testing, negative testing, or formal methods for security properties.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.

* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.

* Protect company assets and customer property.

We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.
